### [1] [Open ultrasound foundation model for robust segmentation and clinical measurement across heterogeneous settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19230)
*Chao Qin,Fahad Shahbaz Khan,Salman Khan,Sarim Ather,Siddiq Anwar,Rao Muhammad Anwer,Shadab Khan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文构建了迄今最大规模的超声资源SonoCorpus与基于其预训练的交互式分割基础模型SonoBase，在跨器官、跨设备、跨操作者与跨地域的十五个评测集上全面超越SAM2、MedSAM2、MedSAM3，并使下游临床指标（射血分数、胎儿头围、孕龄）达到观察者间变异以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超声是全球部署最广的影像模态，但临床AI仍以窄域单任务模型为主，一旦设备、操作者或解剖部位变化即失效，缺乏统一的数据资源与可泛化的超声专用基础模型。

Method: （1）构建SonoCorpus：整合53个公开数据集、456,963张图像与1,626,085个专家标注掩膜，覆盖24个临床应用、17个国家；（2）基于该语料预训练交互式分割基础模型SonoBase，采用超声特异预训练协议；（3）在15个评测数据集上引入新器官、新设备、新操作者与新地域进行跨域评测，并与SAM2、MedSAM2、MedSAM3及同数据训练的单任务专家模型对比；（4）验证少样本（5例）适配能力，并将同一训练协议迁移至SAM3以验证优势来源。

Result: SonoBase在全部15个评测集上均优于SAM2、MedSAM2与MedSAM3，并匹敌相同数据训练的单任务专家模型；在完全外部数据上，其精度超过基线在自身同分布基准上的表现。下游指标：射血分数误差6.63%，处于观察者间变异范围内，除颤器适应证阈值处误分类率13%（基线18%–42%）；胎儿头围误差1.81 mm、孕龄误差1.2天，均低于观察者间变异。基线完全失效的案例占测试集四分之一，SonoBase在其中81%可恢复可用分割，包括塞拉利昂与坦桑尼亚两国由受训较少人员操作手持探头的情形；5个标注样本即可适配新场景；相同训练协议可迁移至SAM3。

Conclusion: 超声专用预训练（而非单一架构）是性能优势的来源；SonoBase可作为可复现平台供社区扩展，论文公开全部检查点、优化器状态、数据划分索引、去重哈希与起始代码。

Abstract: Ultrasound is the most widely deployed imaging modality worldwide, yet clinical AI remains fragmented into narrow single-task models that fail when device, operator, or anatomy changes. Here we present SonoCorpus, an open resource unifying 456,963 images and 1,626,085 expert masks from 53 public datasets spanning 24 clinical applications and 17 countries, and SonoBase, an interactive segmentation foundation model pretrained on it. Across fifteen evaluation datasets introducing new organs, devices, operators, and geographies, SonoBase outperforms SAM2, MedSAM2, and the concept-promptable MedSAM3 on every dataset and matches per-dataset specialist models trained on the same data; on fully external data it exceeds the accuracy these baselines achieve on their own in-distribution benchmarks. Ejection fraction derived from its segmentations falls within inter-observer variability (6.63\% error), with fewer misclassifications at the defibrillator-candidacy threshold than either promptable baseline (13\% versus 18--42\%); fetal head-circumference (1.81~mm) and gestational-age (1.2 days) errors fall below inter-observer variability. Where a baseline fails outright, one in four test cases, SonoBase recovers a usable segmentation in 81\% of them, including on handheld probes operated by minimally trained users in two low- and middle-income countries (Sierra Leone and Tanzania). Five labeled examples can help the model adapt to a new setting, and the identical training protocol transfers well to newer models such as SAM3, locating the advantage in ultrasound-specific pretraining rather than any single architecture. To ensure reproducibility and enable the community to build on SonoBase as a platform, we release all checkpoints, optimizer states, data-split indices, deduplication hashes, and starter code.

</details>


### [2] [RAUL: Reference-Assisted Ureteroscopy Localization for Skill Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19236)
*Fangjie Li,Mai Bui,Charan Mohan,Michael Miga,Matthieu Chabanas,Nicholas Kavoussi,Jie Ying Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RAUL参考辅助重建框架，仅用输尿管镜视频即可恢复器械轨迹并量化导航技能差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输尿管镜碎石术中解剖导航不完整会导致重复干预；熟练外科医生再干预率较低，但缺乏客观指标量化镜体导航表现，无法判定受训者何时达到熟练水平。

Method: 采集每个体模一段缓慢、高质量的参考探查视频生成参考重建，再将后续探查视频定位到该参考上；随后从体模探查轨迹计算导航指标，并跨经验水平比较住院医师。定位精度以电磁跟踪的镜体位姿为金标准进行评价。

Result: 9个体模上平均平移均方根误差为0.5±0.1 mm；相比标准SfM，逐帧定位覆盖率由50.5±14.9%提升至86.1±7.2%；重建轨迹在既有导航指标上显示出高、低经验受训者之间的显著差异。

Conclusion: RAUL相比标准SfM能更完整地从视频恢复输尿管镜轨迹，无需额外跟踪设备即可实现基于轨迹的技能评估；这是首个无需外部跟踪传感器、仅凭视频恢复输尿管镜轨迹用于技能评估的工作，支持输尿管镜导航技能的可扩展自动化评估。

Abstract: Objective: Incomplete navigation of anatomy during ureteroscopic kidney stone surgeries can contribute to repeat interventions. While skilled surgeons have lower reintervention rates, there are no objective metrics to quantify scope-navigation performance to evaluate when a trainee becomes skilled. This work aims to recover ureteroscope trajectories from endoscopic video and derive navigation metrics to quantify differences in skill. Methods: We propose RAUL, a reference-assisted reconstruction framework for recovering ureteroscope trajectories from ureteroscope videos only in phantoms. For each phantom, we use a slow, high-quality reference exploration video to generate a reference reconstruction. We localize subsequent exploration videos against this reference. We evaluate localization accuracy against electromagnetically tracked scope pose. We compute navigation metrics from phantom exploration trajectories to compare surgical residents across experience levels. Results: The proposed reference-assisted framework achieves a mean translation root mean square error of $0.5 \pm 0.1$ mm across 9 phantoms. Compared to standard Structure-from-Motion (SfM), the proposed pipeline increases frame-wise localization coverage from $50.5 \pm 14.9\%$ to $86.1 \pm 7.2\%$ of all video frames. The reconstructed trajectories revealed significant differences between high- and low-experience trainees in established navigation metrics. Conclusion: RAUL enables substantially more complete recovery of ureteroscope trajectories from videos compared to standard SfM pipelines, enabling trajectory-based skill assessment without additional tracking equipment. Significance: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first use of video-only recovery of ureteroscope trajectories without external tracking sensors for skill assessment, supporting scalable automated assessment of ureteroscopy navigation skill.

</details>


### [3] [Can Vision-Language Models Judge Olympic Diving? From Reasoning to Scores in Zero-Shot Action Quality Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19354)
*Henry O. Velesaca,David Freire-Obregon,Luigi Miranda,Abel Reyes-Angulo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该工作评估开源视觉语言模型（VLM）在奥运会跳水视频上的零样本动作质量评估能力，并提出基于回归的集成框架融合VLM语义推理与分阶段子分数，将Spearman相关从不足0.32提升至0.67。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奥运会等竞技体育中的自动动作质量评估（AQA）因人体运动复杂、专家评分主观性强而极具挑战；同时希望探索开源VLM作为可解释、半自动化评分辅助工具的潜力。

Method: 在AQA-7基准数据集上对开源VLM进行零样本AQA评估；提出回归框架，利用VLM生成的语义推理与阶段级（phase-level）子分数，结合TF-IDF向量化、降维与集成学习预测最终比赛得分；采用四模型集成配置并对比文本推理特征与原始数值子分数。

Result: 单独使用VLM时Spearman相关低于0.32；所提集成回归框架显著提升性能，四模型配置下Spearman相关达0.67；文本推理特征持续优于原始数值子分数，表明VLM生成解释的信息更丰富。

Conclusion: VLM在可解释、半自动化体育表现评估中具有较强辅助潜力，文本推理特征对动作质量分析尤为有效；代码已在GitHub公开。

Abstract: Automated action quality assessment (AQA) in Olympic sports remains a challenging task due to the complexity of human motion and the subjectivity inherent in expert judging. This work evaluates the capability of open-source Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to perform zero-shot action quality assessment on Olympic diving videos using the AQA-7 benchmark dataset. In this regard, a regression-based framework is pro-posed to leverage both the semantic reasoning and phase-level sub-scores generated by the VLMs, combining TF-IDF vectorization, dimensionality reduction, and ensemble learning to predict final competition scores. Experimental results show that standalone VLMs achieve moderate Spearman correlations below 0.32, while the proposed ensemble regression framework substantially improves performance in the reported evaluation, reaching a Spearman correlation of 0.67 with a four-model configuration. Textual reasoning features con-sistently outperformed raw numerical sub-scores, highlighting the richness of VLM-generated explanations for action quality analysis. These findings suggest that VLMs hold strong potential as assistive tools for explainable and semi-automated sports performance evaluation. The code is publicly available on GitHub https://github.com/hvelesaca/olympic diving judge vlm

</details>


### [4] [Open-vocabulary 3D object detection with promptable segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19358)
*Ömer Faruk Deniz,Mustafa Taha Koçyiğit*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文探索无需训练、开放词汇的3D目标检测：以SAM3文本提示生成环视图像实例掩码，用无训练几何规则拟合LiDAR点得到3D框，nuScenes上达0.298 mAP/0.348 NDS（零标注成本），并发现主要瓶颈在测量精度而非2D检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动驾驶3D检测器依赖大量人工标注3D框训练，类别表固定、封闭词汇，类别外目标不可见；作者希望验证该任务能否以无需训练、开放词汇的方式完成。

Method: 以可提示分割模型SAM3接收类别名文本提示，在车辆六路环视相机中输出实例掩码，再依据场景几何把掩码转为度量3D框；在nuScenes上进行受控三阶段对比，固定2D检测，仅改变3D几何来源：(1) 纯图像预测几何；(2) 在同一掩码内用无训练规则拟合原始LiDAR点；(3) 推理时借用监督式框几何。反向实验中，用同一掩码构建三状态相机见证规则增强仅用LiDAR的监督检测器。

Result: 纯图像几何0.183 mAP；无训练LiDAR点拟合0.298 mAP/0.348 NDS，零标注成本；借用监督框几何提升至0.413 mAP/0.555 NDS，且类别混淆与置信度校准在该替换下仍保持。反向实验中，无训练见证规则将监督LiDAR检测器从0.596提升至0.630 mAP，约为全监督相机融合增益的一半。覆盖分析显示SAM3以正确命名掩码找到84%的范围内目标；官方指标中失败的类别是被错误命名或几何上难以拟合的，而非未见类别。

Conclusion: 该任务可在无需训练、开放词汇条件下解决；流水线最大短板在于测量精度而非2D检测；轻量无训练几何规则即可零标注获得可观性能，并能以无训练方式部分逼近监督相机融合的增益。

Abstract: Three-dimensional object detection for autonomous driving is dominated by detectors trained on large corpora of human-annotated 3D boxes. Such a detector learns a fixed category list, and everything outside it is invisible. This paper asks whether the task can be solved training-free and open-vocabulary. A promptable segmentation model (SAM3), queried with class names as text prompts, supplies instance masks in the vehicle's six surround-view cameras, and the masks are turned into metric 3D boxes using the geometry of the scene. The core is a controlled three-stage comparison on nuScenes in which 2D detection is held fixed and only the source of 3D geometry changes. Geometry predicted from images alone reaches 0.183 mean average precision (mAP) under the official protocol; fitting boxes from raw LiDAR points inside the same masks with training-free rules reaches 0.298 mAP / 0.348 nuScenes detection score (NDS) at zero labeling cost; borrowing supervised box geometry at inference time lifts the same detections to 0.413 mAP / 0.555 NDS, which locates the pipeline's largest deficit in measurement precision rather than 2D detection, while class confusion and confidence calibration survive that substitution. Reversing the direction, a three-state camera-witness rule built from the same masks improves a supervised LiDAR-only detector from 0.596 to 0.630 mAP, roughly half the gain of fully supervised camera fusion, with no training. A coverage analysis shows that SAM3 finds 84% of in-range objects with a correctly named mask; the classes that fail in the official metric are misnamed or geometrically unforgiving, not unseen.

</details>


### [5] [LinePilot Digitizer: Line-Plot Recovery with Manual and Automatic Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19377)
*Fengbo Ma,Rayan Akhtar,Aakash H. Joshi,Xiaoting Li,Haijian Sun,Zhen Xiang,Xianyan Chen,Yiping Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出LinePilot曲线数字化器（含标准、增强、OCR三种标定模式）与首个专用评测基准DigitizerBench，并采用FPC-NRMSE指标评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从折线图恢复数值序列依赖精确的坐标轴标定与可靠的曲线提取，现有方法缺乏系统评测基准与统一评价指标。

Method: 基于连续颜色曲线恢复，结合三种标定模式；构建DigitizerBench基准，采用正交设计覆盖信号、渲染与图表结构因子，并配合自动与人工引导的双重评测；使用FPC-NRMSE（对缺失、不可用或严重失真输出赋予单位损失）进行评价。

Result: 在DigitizerBench-Full上，LinePilot(OCR)取得最低平均FPC-NRMSE(0.672)与最高可信可用率(38.2%)；在DigitizerBench-Lite上，LinePilot(enhanced)取得最低平均FPC-NRMSE(0.081)、100%输出成功率与最高可信可用率(93.3%)。

Conclusion: 正交基准设计支持因子分析以识别影响数字化器性能的关键因素；三种标定模式在共享曲线恢复流程中提供了自动化、用户控制与精度之间的实用权衡。

Abstract: Recovering numerical series from line plots requires accurate axis calibration and reliable curve extraction. We present LinePilot Digitizer (LinePilot), which combines continuous color-based curve recovery with three calibration modes: LinePilot (standard), LinePilot (enhanced), and LinePilot (OCR). We also introduce DigitizerBench, the first dedicated benchmark for systematically evaluating digitizer performance, using an orthogonal design spanning signal, rendering, and plot-structure factors with complementary automatic and human-guided evaluations. We evaluate performance using failure-penalized capped normalized root-mean-square error (FPC-NRMSE), which assigns unit loss to missing, unusable, or catastrophically inaccurate outputs. On DigitizerBench-Full, LinePilot (OCR) achieves the lowest mean FPC-NRMSE (0.672) and highest trusted usability (38.2%) among the tested automatic pipelines. On DigitizerBench-Lite, LinePilot (enhanced) achieves the lowest mean FPC-NRMSE (0.081), 100% output success, and highest trusted usability (93.3%). The orthogonal benchmark design further enables factor analysis to identify the factors that most significantly affect digitizer performance. Together, the three calibration modes provide a practical trade-off between automation, user control, and accuracy within a shared curve-recovery workflow.

</details>


### [6] [Riemannian--Lorentz Fusion of Vision Transformers and State-Space Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19384)
*Badri N. Patro,Vijay S. Agneeswaran*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Riemannian–Lorentz Parameter Fusion (RLPF)，在异构架构（ViT与SSM）间按语义角色对齐参数组，投影至共同坐标并在Lorentz双曲面上计算正则化测地重心，再解码回两分支，配合可学习门控融合 logits，实现异构模型融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习扩展面临数据枯竭、训练成本指数增长与资源集中等瓶颈；模型融合无需梯度下降即可组合预训练检查点，但现有权重空间融合方法通常要求架构与参数形状对齐，难以融合ViT与SSM这类使用不同token混合算子的异构模型。

Method: RLPF将按语义角色对齐的参数组投影到共同坐标，选取部分坐标提升到双曲空间的Lorentz双曲面模型，计算正则化测地重心并解码到两个分支；组件组使用固定曲率，归一化参数按欧氏处理；最后用可学习门控按输入组合两分支logits。

Result: 微调后系统在CIFAR-10达82.37%，Oxford-IIIT Pet达75.04%，ImageNet-1K top-1达78.58%；对应最佳单亲模型分别为76.54%、71.42%和76.42%。ImageNet-1K上微调前初始化报告为77.80%。

Conclusion: 结果支持进一步研究几何感知的异构融合，但并非免训练的单检查点合并：RLPF是双分支混合体，其门控与最终模型均经训练。

Abstract: Scaling deep learning faces critical bottlenecks: data exhaustion, exponential training costs, and resource concentration. Model merging combines pre-trained checkpoints without gradient descent, offering orders-of-magnitude savings versus retraining. Combining independently trained vision models is difficult when their architectures and parameter shapes differ. Existing weight-space merging methods generally assume aligned, shape-compatible checkpoints, whereas a Vision Transformer (ViT) and a state-space model (SSM) implement token mixing with different operators. We study a hybrid Heterogeneous merging setting that retains both architectures while aligning parameter groups by semantic role. Our proposed Riemannian--Lorentz Parameter Fusion (RLPF) method projects aligned groups to common coordinates, lifts selected coordinates to the Lorentz hyperboloid model of hyperbolic space, computes a regularized geodesic barycenter, and decodes the result into the two branches. A learned gate then combines branch logits for each input. Component groups use fixed curvature values, with normalization parameters treated as Euclidean. In the results available in this manuscript, the fine-tuned system obtains 82.37\% on CIFAR-10, 75.04\% on Oxford-IIIT Pet, and 78.58\% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet-1K; the corresponding best-parent accuracies are 76.54\%, 71.42\%, and 76.42\%. On ImageNet-1K, the reported pre-fine-tuning initialization reaches 77.80\%. These results support further study of geometry-aware heterogeneous fusion, but not a training-free single-checkpoint merge: RLPF is a two-branch hybrid whose gate and reported final models are trained.

</details>


### [7] [WZPlanner: Safe End-to-End Path Planning for Autonomous Driving in Work Zones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19393)
*Nishad Sahu,Changzhong Qian,Guangzhou Cai,Shounak Sural,Ragunathan,Rajkumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出WorkZonePlan数据集与WAVE数据生成流水线，以及联合预测车道边界、工作区边界与驾驶轨迹的BoundaryFormer（BF）及改进版BF++，在闭环评测中取得优于SimLingo与TF++的驾驶分数，且模型尺寸显著更小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工作区通过临时交通管控与封闭改变车道几何，这些信息可能缺失于车载地图，给自动驾驶的感知与规划带来挑战；同时，带有结构化几何监督的公开数据集稀缺，限制了模型的泛化能力。

Method: 构建WorkZonePlan数据集（149K+合成与5K+真实多模态样本，含车道边界、工作区边界与驾驶轨迹选项的3D标注，并提供76个CARLA闭环场景在三种天气下回放得到的228条Bench2Drive格式评测路线）；设计WAVE半自动数据生成流水线；提出基于Transformer的BoundaryFormer（BF），使用slot attention联合预测车道与工作区边界多项式及驾驶轨迹，并消融验证独立轨迹解码器的作用；进一步提出BF++，包含Camera与Camera+LiDAR两种变体，引入度量地平面编码、类型化边界/轨迹查询、长距离点锚点、图像空间曲线细化与保守门控LiDAR融合。

Result: 在评测冻结时四个模型共有的211条路线上，BF++-Camera与BF++-Camera+LiDAR的驾驶分数分别为63.0与64.4，优于SimLingo的59.3与TF++的26.1；BF++参数量比SimLingo小40倍、比TF++小10倍以上，却取得更高驾驶分数。消融显示，使用边界slot特征的独立轨迹解码器相比仅用slot attention的方法显著提升轨迹预测。

Conclusion: 联合预测车道边界、工作区边界与驾驶轨迹是提升工作区自动驾驶安全性的有前景方向。

Abstract: Work zones alter lane geometry through temporary traffic controls and closures that may be absent from on-board maps, challenging autonomous vehicle (AV) perception and planning. Generalization is also limited by scarce public datasets with structured geometric supervision. We present WorkZonePlan, a dataset comprising 149K+ synthetic and 5K+ real-world multimodal samples with 3D annotations for lane boundaries, work zone boundaries, and driving trajectory options. It also provides 76 closed-loop CARLA scenarios replayed under three weather conditions, yielding 228 Bench2Drive-format evaluation routes. We introduce WAVE (Work-zone-focused AV data generation in Virtual and rEal Environments), a semi-automated pipeline for creating the dataset, and BoundaryFormer (BF), a transformer-based model that jointly predicts lane and work zone boundary polynomials and driving trajectories. BF uses slot attention for boundary prediction. Ablations show that a separate trajectory decoder using boundary slot features substantially improves trajectory prediction over a slot-attention-only approach. Building on this finding, BF++ offers Camera and Camera+LiDAR variants with metric ground-plane encoding, typed boundary/trajectory queries, long-range point anchors, image-space curve refinement, and conservative gated LiDAR fusion. In this manner, our RGS can produce smoother geometric surfaces on reflective regions while reducing geometric hollows. To further improve rendering results on reflective regions, we present a reflection-aware densification strategy that is designed to capture specular variations across various views.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MUMU 挑战赛要求用单一高效模型同时完成三项多模态任务，同时满足严格的资源约束，现有方法多将任务独立处理，未充分利用任务间的互补信息。

Abstract: The Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) Challenge requires a single efficient model to jointly perform multi-concept image tagging, open-vocabulary object detection, and image captioning. We present Efficient Unified Multimodal Understanding (EUMU), the winning solution for the MUMU Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge. EUMU builds on a shared pretrained multimodal model, using its prompt-based capabilities for detection and captioning and training lightweight heads on shared visual features to predict quality, scene, and event tags. Rather than treating the three tasks independently, EUMU applies task-aware inference refinement by reusing task outputs as cross-task cues. For detection, caption cues help recover objects missed by the initial detection. For captioning, detection cues help refine the caption to better reflect the detected objects. For tagging, image statistics refine quality predictions, while caption and detection cues refine scene and event predictions. ### [11] [ParticleSplat: Self-supervised Object-centric Latent Particle Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19463)
*Lyuxing He,Daniel Guo,Elizabeth Terveen,Deepak Pathak,David Held,Tal Daniel*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Deep Latent Particles (DLP) 框架以位置、尺度、外观等属性的粒子表示图像，但其本质为 2D，缺乏显式的 3D 空间与几何推理能力，而这对机器人操作等下游任务至关重要。

Method: 利用潜在粒子与 3D 高斯原语之间的结构相似性，引入以新视角合成目标训练的 3D 潜在粒子空间；模型联合编码多视角图像与相机位姿到共享的 3D 以物体为中心的潜在空间，再将粒子转换为与粒子对齐的 3D 高斯，通过其组合重建完整场景。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界数据集上，该公式化方法无需监督即可学习物体掩码，并支持可控的 3D 场景编辑（如在潜在空间中修改粒子以移动物体）；学习的 3D 表示提升了机器人操作任务的下游性能。

Abstract: We present ParticleSplat, a self-supervised object-centric learning method that decomposes scenes into a set of latent ''particles'' representing semantic entities through feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting. Building on the Deep Latent Particles (DLP) framework, which represents images as a set of particles with attributes such as position, scale, and visual appearance, we address a key limitation of DLP: its inherently 2D nature, which prevents explicit 3D spatial and geometric reasoning that are critical for downstream tasks such as robotic manipulation. Leveraging the structural similarity between latent particles and 3D Gaussian primitives, we introduce a 3D latent particle space trained with a novel view synthesis objective. Our model jointly encodes multiple views with camera poses into a shared 3D object-centric latent space, then transforms particles into particle-aligned 3D Gaussians whose composition reconstructs the full scene. On simulated and real-world datasets, we show that this formulation inherently learns object masks without supervision and supports controllable 3D scene editing, such as moving objects by modifying particles in the latent space. We further establish that the learned 3D representation improves downstream performance on robotic manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [12] [SCOUT: Sim-to-Real Text-Based Person Retrieval by Embedding-Space Prediction over Frozen Video Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19483)
*Abdarahmane Traoré,Andy Couturier,Éric Hervet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SCOUT 提出一种冻结编码器方案用于合成到真实（sim-to-real）场景下的文本行人检索：用可训练预测器将冻结视频编码器的 patch token 映射到冻结文本编码器的嵌入空间，以双向 InfoNCE 训练，仅训练预测器；再叠加 ExPLoRA 适配与属性分解重排序提升精度，配合本地-公开校准解释迁移性。AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 上完整"检索-融合-重排"系统达 84.25 mAP@10，单一冻结模型单独提交达 60.63，训练开销约 95 GPU 小时。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有跨模态（文本到图像/视频）行人检索在合成训练数据、真实图像库的 sim-to-real 设定下，通常依赖昂贵的微调交叉编码器（cross-encoder）。本文质疑这一范式，探究"完全冻结编码器 + 轻量可训练预测器"的系统能否与之竞争，以降低训练成本并提升可迁移性。

Method: 将跨模态检索转化为嵌入空间中的预测任务：训练一个预测器，把冻结视频编码器（V-JEPA）的 patch token 映射到冻结文本编码器（EmbeddingGemma）的嵌入空间，目标函数为双向 InfoNCE，基础模型不微调任何编码器，预测器由 Qwen3.5-0.8B 解码器初始化。三个关键组件/发现：（1）用免训练对齐分数筛选与视频特征几何最匹配的文本编码器；（2）两个面向精度的杠杆——视频编码器的参数高效 ExPLoRA 适配，以及基于视觉语言模型的免训练属性分解重排序器；（3）本地-公开校准研究以判断哪些干预可迁移到真实域。

Result: （1）免训练对齐分数对三个候选文本编码器的排序与保留集检索精度一致（Spearman ρ=1.0）；第四个基于 LLM 的编码器显示该规则依赖度量——对邻域重叠分数成立（ρ=0.8），对线性探针不成立（ρ=-0.2）。（2）ExPLoRA 适配 + 属性分解重排序共提升排行榜 R@1 2.2 个点。（3）完整"检索-融合-重排"系统在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 最终榜达 84.25 mAP@10，单一冻结模型单独提交为 60.63；训练组件约耗 95 GPU 小时。

Conclusion: 冻结编码器系统在该检索任务上具备竞争力：文本编码器的选择可由嵌入几何匹配度免训练预测，精度瓶颈可通过精度导向的适配与重排序缓解，并能通过校准判断干预的真实域迁移性。作者微调的交叉编码器 CMP（需 16 GPU-day）是完整系统中的一个融合成员而非替代方案；整套 SCOUT 训练成本约 95 GPU 小时，显著低于传统微调路线。

Abstract: Text-based person retrieval under a sim-to-real gap (synthetic training data, a real-image gallery) is usually tackled with costly fine-tuned cross-encoders. We ask whether a frozen-encoder system can compete. We present SCOUT, which casts cross-modal retrieval as prediction in embedding space. A trainable predictor maps the patch tokens of a frozen video encoder into the embedding space of a frozen text encoder under a bidirectional InfoNCE objective, and no encoder is fine-tuned in the base model. The video encoder is V-JEPA, the text encoder is EmbeddingGemma, and the predictor is initialized from a Qwen3.5-0.8B decoder. We make three findings. First, the best frozen text encoder is simply the one whose geometry best matches the video features. A training-free alignment score ranks three candidate text encoders in the same order as their retrieval accuracy on our held-out split (Spearman $ρ= 1.0$); a fourth, LLM-based encoder shows the rule is metric-dependent, holding for a neighborhood-overlap score ($ρ= 0.8$) but not for a linear probe ($ρ= -0.2$). Second, two precision-targeted levers, parameter-efficient ExPLoRA adaptation of the video encoder and a training-free attribute-decomposed reranker built on a vision-language model, improve the top-rank precision that otherwise limits the frozen system, adding 2.2 points of leaderboard R@1. Third, a local-versus-public calibration study explains which interventions transfer to the real domain. On AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 the full retrieve-fuse-rerank system reaches 84.25 mAP@10 on the final leaderboard, while a single frozen model submitted alone reaches 60.63. Our trained components cost about 95 GPU-hours. CMP, the dataset authors' fine-tuned cross-encoder that trains for sixteen GPU-days, is one fusion member of the full system, not an alternative. Code and annotations: https://github.com/abtraore/SCOUT-ECCV

</details>

Abstract: We present AMB3R-SLAM, a real-time monocular SLAM system capable of reconstructing kilometer-scale trajectories over 10k frames on a single consumer-grade GPU. Our model couples a lightweight front-end for low-latency online tracking with a hierarchical backend that progressively enforces local, mid-level, and global consistency. By avoiding bundle adjustment that relies on the static world assumption, our system naturally handles complex dynamic scenes out of the box. Furthermore, we demonstrate that our method can be extended to leverage stereo, RGB-D, and LiDAR as additional inputs. AMB3R-SLAM achieves strong camera tracking performance across 9 datasets, reducing the absolute trajectory error (ATE) of previous state-of-the-art methods on VBR and Oxford Spires by over 70%. With additional LiDAR input, our model further reduces ATE to sub-meter level on KITTI and VBR datasets.

</details>


### [14] [PerSeM: Persistent Semantic Memory for Long-Horizon Open-Vocabulary UAV Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19542)
*Saurbh Singh Jamwal,Ganesh Ramakrishnan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 PerSeM，一种免训练的持久语义记忆框架，用于无人机长时序开放词汇建图。它把逐帧语义观测关联到持久的世界空间体素，构建多数投票式语义记忆，并通过保留历史的空间细化、可信度感知回放与上下文引导验证进行保守精化。实验表明持久 3D 记忆在语义正确性和时序稳定性上显著优于逐帧预测，PerSeM 还能在全部五个 UAVScenes 序列上取得一致的额外提升，且增益集中于语义困难和时序不稳定区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放词汇分割能为无人机提供丰富的语义感知，但逐帧预测在重复观测和视角变化下存在时序不一致问题。作者希望在不重训练、不增加神经网络推理的前提下，利用持久 3D 聚合提升长时序开放词汇 UAV 建图的语义准确性与时序稳定性。

Method: 提出 PerSeM，一种免训练的持久语义记忆框架：(1) 将逐帧语义观测关联到持久的世界空间体素；(2) 构建基于多数投票的语义记忆；(3) 通过三种保守精化机制对其进行改进——保留历史的空间细化、可信度感知回放、上下文引导验证。

Result: 在 Forest 和 UAVScenes 基准上，持久 3D 记忆相比逐帧预测在语义正确性和时序稳定性上均有显著提升；在全部五个 UAVScenes 序列上 PerSeM 相对该持久记忆基线取得一致的额外改进。基于独立于最终预测所识别区域的分析显示，增益集中在语义困难且时序不稳定的区域，即多数投票记忆最可能仍不确定之处。

Conclusion: 持久 3D 聚合为长时序语义建图提供了坚实基础，而对不确定记忆状态进行保守精化可在无需重训练或额外神经网络推理的情况下带来进一步改进。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary segmentation enables rich semantic perception for UAVs, but frame-wise predictions can remain temporally inconsistent across repeated observations and changing viewpoints. We present PerSeM, a training-free persistent semantic memory framework for long-horizon open-vocabulary UAV mapping. PerSeM associates frame-wise semantic observations with persistent world-space voxels and constructs a majority-based semantic memory, which is conservatively refined through history-preserving spatial refinement, trust-aware replay, and context-guided verification. Experiments on the Forest and UAVScenes benchmarks show that persistent 3D memory provides substantial gains in semantic correctness and temporal stability over frame-wise predictions. Beyond this strong persistent-memory baseline, PerSeM provides consistent additional improvements, improving both semantic accuracy and temporal stability across all five evaluated UAVScenes sequences. Analysis using regions identified independently of the final PerSeM predictions further shows that these gains are concentrated in semantically difficult and temporally unstable regions, where majority-based memory is most likely to remain uncertain. Abstract: Artificial intelligence for plant disease analysis has advanced from task-specific classifiers to multi-modal models capable of jointly interpreting visual and textual information. Abstract: This study developed and evaluated a deep-learning-based perception framework for selective robotic cotton picking. Among the detection models, GELAN-s achieved the most favorable balance between mean average precision (mAP) and inference speed, obtaining an mAP of 86.1%, precision of 81.6%, recall of 76.6%, and an F1-score of 79.0%, with an average inference time of 42.3 ms per image. Abstract: We present VGGT-GS SLAM, a monocular 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM system designed for uncalibrated videos. Starting from feed-forward VGGT pose and depth priors, our system performs submap differentiable bundle adjustment that jointly refines camera poses and a 3D Gaussian map, while optimizing submap-shared intrinsics and radial--tangential distortion through analytic calibration Jacobians. To improve global consistency, we introduce Gaussian-native alignment (GNA) for camera-anchored scale refinement between sequential submaps and verification of loop-closure candidates. Extensive experiments on standard indoor benchmarks show consistent improvements in localization accuracy and strong rendering quality under uncalibrated settings, establishing a strong baseline for uncalibrated Gaussian SLAM.

</details>


### [18] [Instance Segmentation and Fine-grained Classification for Urban Buildings with Adaptive Region Dividing and Spatially-Supervised Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19631)
*Weiyuan Zhang,Qi Zhang,Hui Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出自适应区域划分策略与统一场景级评估，结合点变换器与空间监督对比损失，实现城市建筑实例分割与细粒度功能分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模城市点云的实例级与功能级理解对数字城市建模至关重要，但现有方法依赖预定义分块训练与评估，实际应用中难以获得，且引入额外预处理并割裂完整的建筑结构；同时城市建筑细粒度分类研究较少。

Method: 将3D点云投影至BEV平面，用预训练分割模型检测建筑区域，边界框反投影回原始点云构建结构对齐的自适应训练块，实现语义引导的动态划分；对每个分割建筑，点变换器分类器联合编码主体与局部上下文（几何、颜色、核心上下文信息），采用类平衡加权交叉熵缓解类别不平衡，并提出空间监督对比损失，对空间近邻同类建筑赋予更大权重以增强类间判别力。

Abstract: Accurate instance-level and functional understanding of urban buildings in large-scale point clouds is essential for digital city modeling and urban analysis. However, the extensive spatial coverage of urban scenes leads most existing methods to rely on predefined blocks for training and evaluation, although such partitions are rarely available in real-world applications and introduce additional preprocessing while fragmenting complete building structures. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive region-dividing strategy with unified scene-level evaluation. Specifically, the 3D point cloud is projected onto a bird's-eye-view (BEV) plane, where a pretrained segmentation model is used to detect building regions. The detected bounding boxes are then back-projected to the original point cloud to construct structure-aligned adaptive training blocks, enabling semantically guided dynamic partitioning without manual design. Furthermore, beyond instance-level understanding, few methods have explored fine-grained classification for urban buildings, and thus we also put forward a fine-grained classification model for urban buildings with a spatially-supervised contrastive loss. First, for each segmented building, a point transformer classifier jointly encodes its body and local context using geometric, color, and core-context information. Then, the class-balanced weighted cross-entropy is used to alleviate severe class imbalance. The proposed spatially-supervised contrastive loss further enhances inter-class discriminability by assigning greater weight to spatially proximate, same-category buildings, encouraging compact functional representations while separating easily confused categories. Extensive experiments on UrbanBIS and STPLS3D demonstrate the advantages of the proposed method in building instance segmentation and fine-grained classification compared to existing SOTA methods.

</details>

*Yinuo Zhang,Bingshuo Liu,Zhiying Tu,Dianhui Chu,Qingbin Liu,Xi Chen,Jiang Bian,Xiaoyan Yu,Dianbo Sui*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学图像质量评估任务复杂，需同时兼顾人类专家的评判标准与模型的理解能力，现有方法难以准确对齐专家判断。

Result: 实验结果表明，该框架能有效对齐人类专家的评判标准；最终在ICME 2026 Grand Challenges的SIQA挑战赛SIQA-U赛道中获得第1名。

Conclusion: 所提出的RAG框架在科学图像质量评估中表现优异，验证了多模态检索增强方法在该任务上的有效性。

Abstract: This paper proposes a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework for scientific image quality assessment, designed to simultaneously address both the understanding track (SIQA-U) and the scoring track (SIQA-S) of the SIQA challenge. We construct a multimodal index that integrates textual semantics with fine-grained visual features, and develop a multi-route retrieval and fusion mechanism to provide large language models with highly relevant reference cases, thereby enhancing their capability to evaluate complex scientific images. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively aligns with the judgment criteria of human experts. Ultimately, our method achieves 1st place in the SIQA-U track of the SIQA challenge at the ICME 2026 Grand Challenges.

</details>


### [20] [Towards Active Cross-View Object Geo-Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19662)
*Shunyu Yao,Xiaohan Zhang,Zhuoran Yang,Haoqi Lai,Qi Ming,Xiaoxi Hu,Hui-Liang Shen,Si-Yuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出主动跨视角目标地理定位任务ActiveGeo及框架ActiveMoPT，通过智能体主动选择视角并决定停止时机，以最少观测提升定位精度，并在主动基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统跨视角目标地理定位（CVOGL）假设查询图像固定，忽视了移动智能体主动获取更具信息量观测的能力，导致定位精度与观测效率难以兼顾。

Method: 提出ActiveMoPT框架，包含三阶段训练：1）多视角提示保持适配，聚合多个查询视角并复用初始提示；2）轨迹引导策略初始化，利用监督智能体轨迹学习视角选择与初始停止行为；3）代价感知策略精炼，采用GRPO与增益-代价奖励联合优化定位精度和观测效率。同时构建ActiveGeo-858零样本测试集（858个场景、1716个目标标注）。

Result: 在MoP-UAV上，ActiveMoPT平均仅用1.45个查询视角即达到SOTA性能；在ActiveGeo-858零样本评估中显著优于以往CVOGL方法。

Conclusion: 主动视角选择与自适应停止机制可有效提升跨视角地理定位的精度与效率，验证了ActiveGeo任务与ActiveMoPT框架的有效性。

Abstract: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) typically assumes a fixed query image, overlooking the ability of mobile agents to actively acquire more informative observations. To address this limitation, we introduce Active Cross-View Object Geo-Localization (ActiveGeo), where an agent sequentially selects new viewpoints and determines when to stop, aiming to improve localization with minimal observations. We further propose ActiveMoPT, an ActiveGeo framework with three-stage training. First, Multi-View Prompt-Preserving Adaptation enables the model to aggregate multiple query views while reusing the initial prompt. Second, Trajectory-Guided Policy Initialization uses supervised agent trajectories to learn viewpoint selection and initial stopping behavior. Third, Cost-Aware Policy Refinement employs GRPO with a gain-cost reward to jointly optimize localization accuracy and observation efficiency. We also construct ActiveGeo-858, a zero-shot test set containing 858 scenes and 1,716 target annotations. Experiments show that ActiveMoPT achieves state-of-the-art performance on MoP-UAV using only 1.45 query views on average, and substantially outperforms previous CVOGL approaches under zero-shot evaluation on ActiveGeo-858.

</details>


### [21] [VideoResearcher: Self-Improving Tool Design for Long-Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19664)
*Dingqiang Ye,Dongdi Zhao,Kaishen Wang,Qingqiao Hu,Jingchen Sun,Yijun Liang,Yuqi Jia,Yiqiao Huang,Yunjie Tian,Jiaxing Zhang,Chuanyang Jin,Ke Zhang,Vishal M. Patel,Di Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 VideoResearcher——一个免训练的多智能体框架，可自主设计、测试并改进视频理解工具，通过"求解循环+进化循环"双循环机制，在无需更新模型参数的情况下达到自改进智能体的最优性能，并接近人工设计的性能上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频理解中的视频智能体系统通常依赖成本高、耗时的人工设计与反复试错；现有自改进方法要么仅优化低影响的提示词、要么重组预定义微工具，或在harness优化中难以收敛，因此亟需一种能够自主开发高影响力视频工具的方法。

Method: VideoResearcher 为免训练（training-free）多智能体框架，像人类研究者一样自主设计、测试和精炼视频理解工具。其核心为双循环结构：Solving Loop 与 Evolving Loop。二者协同工作——分析工具使用轨迹以识别能力缺口，协调专用智能体开发并验证可执行工具，并在后续视频推理中复用已进化工具以强化证据获取；通过迭代式工具精炼与验证逐步增强证据获取能力，且不更新模型参数。

Result: 在自改进智能体中取得state-of-the-art性能，并接近人工设计的上界（human-designed upper bound）。

Conclusion: 验证了一种面向长视频理解的免训练范式：通过自主工具开发扩展智能体能力，同时减少昂贵的人工工程投入。

Abstract: Video agents have made substantial progress in long-video understanding. Yet effective video-agent systems require costly, time-consuming manual design and trial and error. Current self-improvement methods either refine low-impact prompts, recombine predefined micro-tools, or struggle with convergence in harness optimization. To bridge this gap, we target high-impact video-tool with VideoResearcher, a training-free multi-agent framework that autonomously designs, tests, and refines tools for video understanding, like a human researcher. VideoResearcher operates through dual Solving and Evolving loops: it analyzes tool-use trajectories to identify capability gaps, coordinates specialized agents to develop and validate executable tools, and reuses evolved tools to strengthen evidence acquisition in subsequent video reasoning. Through iterative tool refinement and validation, it progressively strengthens evidence acquisition without updating model parameters. VideoResearcher achieves state-of-the-art performance among self-improving agents and approaches the human-designed upper bound, demonstrating a training-free paradigm for long-video understanding that expands agent capabilities through autonomous tool development while reducing costly manual engineering.

</details>


### [22] [Beyond Patch Removal: Persistent Adversarial Effects in Vision-Language-Action Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19669)
*Enhao Wu,Fusen Guo,Yuxin Cao,Ziyang Lyu,Lin Li,Wei Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究VLA策略在对抗性补丁移除后的持久状态效应，提出状态恢复协议将"即时动作破坏"与"持久状态影响"分离评估，发现移除补丁后大部分回合仍不可恢复，并提出恢复适配器，其效果高度依赖干预时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有对VLA策略的对抗补丁评估多采用持续攻击设定，将补丁一直保留在观测中，因而无法区分两类后果：补丁存在时的即时动作破坏，以及补丁移除后仍残留的持久状态效应。缺少这种区分会导致对攻击后果与恢复可行性的误判。

Method: 提出状态恢复协议：在匹配的动作分块（action-chunk）边界移除补丁，并在相同的剩余步数预算下测量后续可恢复性。设置四类对照以剥离混杂因素：干净输入、随机补丁（排除遮挡效应）、偏差匹配对照（匹配动作误差幅度）、固定方向对照（排除方向持续性）。同时训练一个恢复适配器（recovery adapter），在攻击诱导状态上训练，并在受控的干预时延下评估。实验对象为OpenVLA-OFT与自回归OpenVLA，攻击方法为EDPA，任务为LIBERO-Long。

Result: 在OpenVLA-OFT上，EDPA攻击后经过五个动作分块，仅36.2%的LIBERO-Long回合仍可恢复；偏差匹配与固定方向对照分别为89.9%与87.0%。自回归OpenVLA上观察到类似的持久效应。恢复适配器在一步分块时延下将恢复率从7.7%提升至47.4%，但随着干预延迟增加，收益显著下降。

Conclusion: 对抗补丁的影响不止于补丁在场时的即时动作破坏，还会在补丁移除后以持久状态效应形式残留，且该效应不能由遮挡、动作误差幅度或方向持续性解释。及时干预对恢复至关重要，恢复适配器仅在低时延下有效，时延增大则效果急剧衰减。

Abstract: Adversarial patches to Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies can cause both immediate action corruption and persistent state effects that remain after the patch is removed. Abstract: Pre-trained 3D vision models have substantially advanced point cloud analysis, yet adapting them to downstream tasks via full fine-tuning is computationally expensive and storage-intensive. Specifically, we introduce a Point Shift Prompter that extracts multi-granular geometric features across different scales, enabling instance-specific geometric adjustments during adaptation. Next, a Keypoint Prompter adaptively generates point-level prompts to highlight local geometric saliency and fine-grained structural details. Furthermore, a Prompt Propagation mechanism injects these multi-granular geometric cues throughout the feature extraction hierarchy, strengthening the ability to capture essential geometric characteristics. ### [27] [Recency Forcing: Bridging the Long-Horizon Gap in Autoregressive Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19729)
*Tri Cao,Hung Nguyen,Phong Nguyen,Khoi Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文揭示了自回归视频生成中"KV逐出失配"的训练-推理差异问题，提出Recency Forcing方法，通过对注意力logits施加时间步相关的非正偏置，渐进衰减远距离帧影响，并借助BAR重参数化实现零开销FlashAttention兼容，在VBench上取得SOTA长程生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归视频生成在长时程下性能退化严重。作者指出一个被忽视的训练-推理不一致现象——KV逐出失配：训练时使用短片段，所有上下文帧都在KV cache中；推理时受显存限制，远距离帧被迫从KV cache逐出，导致模型失去了原本依赖的上下文条件。已有的"上下文截断"模拟逐出方式会丢弃模型仍需要的时间信息，损害运动连贯性。

Method: 1) 引入位置响应度量 R(Δ, t_denoise)，通过扰动分析量化上下文影响随时间距离与去噪步数的变化规律；2) 提出Recency Forcing，在pre-softmax注意力logits上施加由R直接导出的、非正且随时间步变化的Temporal Response Bias (TRB)，在不改变上下文长度与训练目标的前提下弥合训练-推理差距；3) 提出Biased Attention Reparameterization (BAR)，将偏置移出softmax的精确重参数化，使TRB转化为标准FlashAttention调用，零额外开销；4) 支持training-free与training-based两种模式。

Result: 在VBench和VBench-Long基准上，Recency Forcing实现了当前最优（SOTA）的长时程视频生成质量，且不增加任何额外推理成本。

Conclusion: 通过保留上下文但渐进衰减远距离帧影响力的方式替代硬性逐出，可有效解决KV逐出失配问题；Recency Forcing以零推理开销提升长时程自回归视频生成质量，兼具免训练与可训练两种实用模式。

Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video generation degrades over long horizons due to an overlooked train-inference discrepancy we term KV eviction mismatch: models train on short clips where all context frames reside in the KV cache, but at inference, memory constraints force distant frames to be evicted from the KV cache - removing context the model was conditioned on. Rather than simulating eviction via context truncation - which discards temporal information the model still needs and degrades motion coherence - we keep the context but while progressively reducing the influence of distant frames, making their eventual eviction negligible. To guide this design, we introduce the positional response $R( Δ, \, t_{\text{denoise}})$, a perturbation-based sensitivity measure revealing that context influence decays steeply with temporal distance and varies systematically across denoising steps. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Recency Forcing, which applies a non-positive, timestep-dependent bias, termed Temporal Response Bias (TRB), on pre-softmax attention logits derived directly from $R$, closing the train-inference gap without modifying context length or training objectives. We further introduce Biased Attention Reparameterization (BAR), an exact reformulation that moves the bias outside the softmax, making TRB a standard FlashAttention call at zero overhead. Recency Forcing operates in both training-free mode and training-based mode. Experiments on VBench and VBench-Long demonstrate state-of-the-art long-horizon generation quality at no additional inference cost.

</details>

Abstract: Recent innovations in deep learning have significantly enhanced the diagnosis of medical images, although they are based on the use of centralized data storage that pose severe threats to patient privacy and medical data security. *Yuheng Shi,Xiaohuan Pei,Minjing Dong,Chang Xu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Vision-RL2，用区域级强化学习优化RoI提议网络，实现粗视图定位+高分辨识别，在减少约4倍视觉token的情况下超越全预算基线精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM细粒度感知通常靠提高分辨率实现，但会显著增加视觉token数量，推高视觉编码与语言模型预填充开销。作者发现细粒度感知包含两个子操作——RoI定位与内容识别——它们对分辨率的需求不同：定位能容忍约3-4倍更强的token压缩，识别则不能。因此应"从粗视图定位、把分辨率集中在被选中的证据上"。但现有定位方案存在缺陷：用MLLM解码坐标可端到端训练，却每次查询需一次完整前向且依赖定位能力；从注意力蒸馏的轻量提议网络虽快，却继承了注意力目标的噪声；且提议网络经离散区域选择到达答案，答案的忠实度无法直接监督该网络。

Method: Vision-RL2将连贯区域视为动作，用冻结的MLLM阅读器评估每个区域：以其移除后答案似然的变化作为奖励。采用互补的减性（subtractive）与加性（additive）目标，分别抑制干扰性提议与召回缺失证据；仅更新预测器，无需区域标注、响应采样或推理轨迹。精炼后的提议进一步支持稀疏编码，放大证据区域并排除背景token。

Result: 在6个细粒度基准和4个MLLM骨干上，Vision-RL2在每个token预算下均优于基模型，并能以约4倍更少的视觉token达到基模型最大预算时的精度。

Conclusion: 细粒度感知的定位与识别具有不同分辨率需求，将分辨率集中到经强化学习精炼的RoI上，可在显著降低视觉token开销的同时提升细粒度视觉感知性能。代码已开源。

Abstract: Fine-grained visual perception in MLLMs is commonly improved by raising the resolution, but the added visual tokens inflate vision-encoding and language-model prefilling costs. We show that the two operations underlying fine-grained perception, localizing the region of interest (RoI) and recognizing its content, have different resolution requirements. In a controlled diagnostic, localization tolerates roughly 3 to 4 times stronger token compression than recognition, which motivates localizing from a coarse view and concentrating resolution on the selected evidence. Decoding coordinates with the MLLM can be trained end-to-end from answers, but costs a full model pass per query and depends on grounding ability. A lightweight proposal network distilled from the model's attention is fast, but inherits the noise of its attention targets. The RoI from the proposal network reaches the answer through a discrete region choice, so its faithfulness to the answer cannot supervise the network. ### [30] [STAR: Structure-aware Test-time Adaptation for diffusion-based light field Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19747)
*Wontae Choi,Ki Ryum Moon,Jae Young Lee,Hyung Sup Yun,Il Yong Chun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出STAR——首个面向光场重建的测试时自适应框架，通过冻结预训练扩散先验并拟合三个轻量适配器，联合适配光场空间-角度结构的三个组成部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We propose SnapPhysics, a training-free framework that reconstructs 3D objects and estimates their physical properties such as mass, friction, and center of gravity from a single image. For physically coherent interactions in mixed reality (MR), such properties are as important as geometry.   <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 1) 类型化表示：把剧本证据、所需角色/道具/场景、各主体站位、摄影机行为编码为带类型的值，值在所属层级（script、scene、shot、panel）只写一次并向下继承。2) 编译器将该表示同时转译为两部分：发送给扩散模型的提示词，以及在米制尺度下构建的 3D 场景。3) 相机求解器放置摄影机，使声明取景与实际构建取景一致。4) 评估方式为逐字段几何测量，量化编译后相机与分镜渲染相对声明的偏差，而非依赖模型打分。

Result: 在 11 个场景的 Automatic Drive 剧本上，所有单主体分镜将该主体置于其声明位置 1.2% 画幅宽度以内；当存在两或三个主体时，单一相机位姿无法同时满足所有位置，残差被显式报告而非被吸收。在 204 个外部导演分镜镜头中，交付的头部高度分别为：导演文字目标值的 1.906 倍、编译提示词的 1.733 倍、灰盒控制条件的 0.955 倍——即取景保持最好的条件所绘制的动作最少。在 30 个镜头上显式声明姿态，使绘制出的动作从 58.9% 提升到 74.4%，且不改变取景。

Conclusion: PACE 证明可将剧本到镜头的空间规划外化为可测量、可继承的类型化表示，并通过编译器与相机求解器实现"声明即取景"的可验证对齐；显式声明姿态能提升动作表达而不牺牲取景。转场、拟合运动以及生成分镜的人工复核仍为待解决问题。

Abstract: Between a screenplay and a film sits a planning problem that is spatial first: who stands where, and what a camera sees from where it stands. An image diffusion model asked for a shot in free text settles that plan by its own defaults. We present PACE (Precise AI Cinematic Expression), a typed representation for the plan: the screenplay evidence, the characters, props and locations it needs, where each subject stands, and what the camera does. A value is written once at the level it belongs to (script, scene, shot or panel) and inherited below it. A compiler turns the result into both the prompt sent to the diffusion model and a 3D scene built in metres, and a camera solver places the camera so that the declared framing is the framing built. Where a declared value becomes geometry, PACE measures, field by field, how far the compiled camera and the staged render sit from the declaration, rather than asking a model to judge.

On 204 external director-storyboard shots, delivered head height is 1.906 times the staged target from the director's words, 1.733 from the compiled prompt, and 0.955 with the greybox control; the condition that holds framing best draws the described action least. Declaring the pose on 30 shots raises the action drawn from 58.9% to 74.4% without moving the framing. Transitions, fitted motion and human review of the generated panels remain open. </details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有异构任务联合学习多依赖特征共享、蒸馏或辅助监督来实现"任务耦合"，但跨任务场景中表示粒度与监督粒度不匹配，容易导致干扰、教师偏差或单向坍塌。作者认为跨粒度学习本质上是层次化交互调控问题，而非简单任务耦合；该问题在UAV感知中尤为突出——视觉偏移使检测与分割目标分别对应粗粒度与细粒度知识源。

Method: 1) 构建CrossUAV：面向UAV的联合目标检测与实例分割基准，为跨粒度任务协作提供统一评测平台；2) 提出Cross-Granularity Socialized Collaboration（CGSC）框架，在网络各层级上调控任务何时（when）、何处（where）、以何种方式（how）交换信息；3) CGSC渐进激活跨任务交互，并根据任务贡献自适应调整交互强度，从而抑制有害干扰、利用粗-细粒度互补结构。

Result: 大量实验表明，CGSC在目标检测与实例分割两个任务上均取得一致的性能提升，验证了层次化动态交互是跨粒度协作的有效机制。

Conclusion: 跨粒度协作的关键在于对层次化交互进行动态调控而非静态任务耦合；CrossUAV基准与CGSC框架共同为UAV场景下检测-分割协同提供了可评测的平台与有效方法。

Abstract: Joint learning across heterogeneous tasks is often treated as task coupling through feature sharing, distillation, or auxiliary supervision. However, in cross-task learning, mismatched representational and supervisory granularities make such coupling prone to interference, teacher bias, or unidirectional collapse. We argue that cross-granularity learning is fundamentally a problem of hierarchical interaction regulation rather than simple task coupling. This issue is particularly evident in UAV perception, where visual shifts and detection--segmentation objectives naturally form coarse- and fine-grained knowledge sources. To systematically study this problem, we introduce CrossUAV, a UAV benchmark for joint object detection and instance segmentation that provides a unified evaluation platform for cross-granularity task collaboration. To address these challenges, we propose Cross-Granularity Socialized Collaboration (CGSC), a progressive and adaptive framework that regulates when, where, and how tasks exchange information across network hierarchies. CGSC progressively activates cross-task interactions and adaptively adjusts the strength according to task contribution, suppressing harmful interference while exploiting complementary coarse- and fine-grained structures. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent improvements on both tasks, validating hierarchical dynamic interaction as an effective mechanism for cross-granularity collaboration.

</details>

Abstract: 3D assembly is fundamental to modern manufacturing and digital content creation. In this paper, we present PART, a unified transformer-based framework for 3D part retrieval and assembly: given a target shape and a part library, PART automatically selects the appropriate parts and predicts their 6-DoF poses to reconstruct the target. While prior work has achieved impressive progress on assembling a pre-defined set of parts, this more practical retrieval-based setting remains largely unexplored. The task faces three key challenges: (i) a combinatorially explosive search space that grows exponentially with library size; (ii) variable-length outputs, as different targets require different numbers of parts; and (iii) continuous 6-DoF pose estimation for part assembly. To address these, we formulate retrieval and assembly as a set prediction problem and design a novel transformer-based framework that retrieves parts and regresses their poses with variable-length output. Additionally, we exploit the duality between part pose estimation and target segmentation through joint training and a novel segmentation-enhanced optimization module. Finally, We curate a large-scale dataset of 80K+ shapes, and the results show that PART generalizes to scene layouts, image targets, and real-world scans. Abstract: We propose a new probabilistic model for general-purpose medical image registration that builds upon the mutual information registration criterion. We also demonstrate a corresponding sampler that can quantify, for the first time, uncertainty in multimodal registration scenarios with very high-dimensional 3D deformations. Our code, which we call BINDER (Bayesian INference for DEformable Registration), is freely available at https://github.com/ste93ste/BINDER.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 楼层平面图室内视觉定位当前的瓶颈在于室内数据而非模型架构；SlugTrails 提供了面向大空间真实部署的基准、协议与工具（https://github.com/Head-inthe-Cloud/SlugTrails），可用于公平对比不同感知范式并推动数据驱动的性能提升。

Abstract: Floor-plan-based indoor visual localization enables infrastructure-free positioning, but most methods are developed and evaluated in small residential environments unlike the large public buildings of real deployment. We introduce SlugTrails, a floor plan localization benchmark for large indoor spaces under realistic egocentric sensing: $30$ Hz Aria glasses recordings across three campus buildings and six floors ($22089$ m$^2$ of floor plan outline), CAD-derived floor plans with semantic classes and circulation space masks, and trajectories aligned into the floor plan frame using laser-surveyed anchors. One protocol covers three practical ways of gathering geometry under a limited field of view -- a single walking frame, a stationary multi-view sweep, and a walking stream with odometry -- so methods designed for different regimes are compared on the same buildings and ground truth. Evaluating five representative geometric and learned systems under their native sensing configurations, we find that stock checkpoints (official released weights) are near zero on SlugTrails (at most $0.004$ R@1m30$^{\circ}$ on walking single frames), while fine-tuning on SlugTrails improves every trainable family on all three tasks (e.g., F$^3$Loc $0.0 \rightarrow 0.141$ single-frame and $0.03 \rightarrow 0.66$ sequential), with gains compounding as observations accumulate. The same fine-tuned weights also improve cross-dataset generalization on LaMAR with no LaMAR training (sequential R@1m $0.048 \rightarrow 0.143$ for F$^3$Loc and $0.063 \rightarrow 0.127$ for UnLoc), whereas train-from-scratch on SlugTrails alone stays far below fine-tuning from stock weights -- evidence that floor plan localization is currently limited by indoor data rather than by architecture.   <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 结果表明，大规模、可控的视觉经验能够有效改善具身感知：既可作为监督数据提升真实世界任务性能，又可作为受控实验平台揭示观察者具身属性对感知学习的作用。

Abstract: Embodied visual perception relies on temporally coherent visual experience accumulated through continuous engagement with the environment. However, collecting large-scale egocentric binocular observations together with dense annotations remains costly and difficult. Moreover, visual experience is shaped not only by the environment but also by the embodiment of the observer, including viewing height, field of view, binocular geometry, and motion through the scene. To address these challenges, we present BinoGen, an automated framework for generating large-scale, embodiment-aware egocentric binocular visual experiences in indoor environments. BinoGen jointly models environmental and observer variation through generative scene synthesis, probabilistic object instantiation, appearance randomization, stochastic trajectory generation, and configurable binocular camera setups. The framework produces synchronized binocular videos together with dense multimodal supervision, including depth maps, optical flow, surface normals, semantic maps, object coordinates, and camera poses. Using BinoGen, we construct a dataset comprising more than 20 million annotated images for supervised learning. We demonstrate two complementary utilities of BinoGen. First, incorporating BinoGen data consistently improves real-world visual perception, including depth estimation, object detection, and video object tracking. Second, paired human-inspired and mouse-inspired observations from the same environments enable controlled investigation of how observer embodiment affects perceptual learning. Embodiment-specific adaptation substantially improves performance, while joint training enables a single model to perform competitively across both embodiments. Together, these results demonstrate that large-scale, controllable visual experience can improve embodied perception...

</details>


### [42] [GS-PI: An Optimization-Decoupled Appearance Decomposition Approach for Generating PBR Gaussian Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19907)
*Jieting Xu,Rengan Xie,Zijian Huang,Zehui Jin,Rui Wang,Yuchi Huo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GS-PI 将 PBR 材质生成重构为 3D 点云上的几何条件扩散过程，实现优化解耦，产出可重光照的 PBR-GS 资产。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gaussian Splatting 编码的是烘焙辐射，光照与几何纠缠，难以接入 PBR 管线；现有逆渲染方法通过联合优化解耦材质，但目标相互竞争，导致严重歧义与残余光照伪影。

Method: 方法在 3D 域直接操作以保证多视角一致性，避免 2D 扩散的像素对应问题。提出多尺度跨视角条件机制，融合全局语义先验、源锚定光度线索与绝对空间学习的视线方向条件信号，压缩多视角证据、缓解跨视角投影错位，防止高光烘焙进本征颜色。流程为：从预训练 GS 提取点云 → 条件扩散预测 PBR 属性 → 可微光栅化蒸馏回，得到可重光照 PBR-GS 资产。

Result: GS-PI 优于近期逆渲染基线，且以“学习式扩散 + 短时目标驱动蒸馏”替代逐场景联合光照/BRDF 优化，无需代理网格。

Conclusion: 该优化解耦框架在保证多视角一致性的同时提升材质解耦质量与重光照能力，为 GS 接入 PBR 管线提供了无需网格的有效方案。

Abstract: Gaussian Splatting (GS) excels at novel-view synthesis but encodes baked-in radiance, tightly entangling illumination with geometry and preventing seamless integration into physically based rendering (PBR) pipelines. Existing inverse-rendering methods attempt to disentangle materials via joint optimization, but often suffer from competing objectives that cause severe ambiguities and residual lighting artifacts. To overcome this, we present GS-PI, a novel optimization-decoupled framework that casts PBR material generation as a geometry-conditioned diffusion process on 3D point clouds. By operating directly in the 3D domain, our method inherently guarantees multi-view consistency, sidestepping the severe pixel correspondence issues that challenge 2D diffusion approaches. We introduce a multi-scale cross-view conditioning mechanism that integrates three complementary components: a global semantic prior, source-anchored photometric cues, and an absolute spatial learned view-direction conditioning signal. This design efficiently compresses complex multi-view evidence, mitigating cross-view projection misalignment and successfully preventing specular highlights from baking into intrinsic colors. By extracting a point cloud from a pre-trained Gaussian model, predicting PBR attributes via conditional diffusion, and distilling them back through differentiable rasterisation, we yield a fully relightable PBR-GS asset. GS-PI outperforms recent inverse-rendering baselines while replacing per-scene joint illumination/BRDF optimization with a learned diffusion pass followed by a short target-driven distillation, without requiring proxy meshes.

</details>


### [43] [CitySTAR: Structured and Topology-Aware Reasoning for Open-Vocabulary Urban 3D Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19911)
*Shuai Zhang,Hongye Hou,Qinghe Liu,Zhuoxiao Li,Dongli Wu,Jing Ou,Yuan Liu,Wufan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架 CitySTAR，将城市级 3D 定位重构为结构化约束推理，并发布增强基准 CitySTAR-3D。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 3D 定位方法多依赖特征相似度或直接匹配，难以将自然语言意图与十亿级城市点云中隐含的语义与几何结构关联起来。

Method: 将描述语义组织为面向开放词汇 3D 实体、属性与空间关系的可计算跨模态约束；把原始点云提升为开放词汇 3D 实例的场景图，借助 CodeLLM 驱动的工具提供多模态证据；用成对超图建模目标-上下文拓扑并进行双向拓扑验证以消解结构歧义；最后由反思式跨模态定位模块结合拓扑一致性与候选为中心的 2D 视觉证据，在度量感知的 3D 上下文图上决策。

Result: 大量实验表明 CitySTAR 在开放世界城市 3D 定位上持续提升，并保持较强的可解释性与泛化能力。

Conclusion: CitySTAR 以免训练方式实现推理驱动的城市 3D 定位，配合覆盖度更优的 CitySTAR-3D 基准，为城市级 3D 定位提供了新范式。

Abstract: 3D grounding aims to localize target entities in complex scenes from natural language and plays a fundamental role in embodied perception and spatial reasoning. However, existing approaches mostly rely on feature similarity or direct matching, making it difficult to connect natural-language intent with the implicit semantic and geometric structures hidden in billion-scale urban point clouds. We reformulate city-scale 3D grounding as structured constraint reasoning, where description semantics are organized into computable cross-modal constraints over open-vocabulary 3D entities, attributes, and spatial relations. We present CitySTAR, a training-free framework for reasoning-driven urban 3D grounding. CitySTAR lifts raw billion-scale urban point clouds into a query-ready scene graph of open-vocabulary 3D instances, with CodeLLM-driven tools supplying multimodal evidence for node attributes and 3D spatial relations. It then models target-context topology with paired hypergraphs and performs bidirectional topology verification for structural disambiguation. Finally, a Reflective Cross-modal Grounding module integrates topology consistency and candidate-centered 2D visual evidence to make decisions over a metric-aware 3D context graph. To further support this setting, we introduce CitySTAR-3D, an enhanced benchmark that improves semantic coverage, instance completeness, bounding-box fidelity, and spatial-relation complexity in city-scale 3D grounding. Extensive experiments show that CitySTAR consistently improves open-world urban 3D grounding while maintaining strong interpretability and generalization.

</details>


### [44] [DirtyMoCap: Robust Motion Capture from Unconstrained Markers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19927)
*Long Wang,Shuting Zhao,Shen Yan,Siyuan Yu,Xiaoben Li,Zeyu Cai,Yumeng Hou,Yuliang Xiu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DirtyMoCap 提出一种无需标记布局的鲁棒框架，将无序稀疏噪声标记映射到"代理锚点"，再用可微 Gauss-Newton 求解器拟合 SMPL-H 模型，单模型即可泛化到任意布局，并实现最高 100 倍加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光学动作捕捉虽能提供高保真人体运动，但严重依赖严格标记布局与干净轨迹，现实中跟踪系统常输出稀疏、含噪、无序且配置未知或变化的点云。为弥合"脏"原始标记与参数化人体模型之间的差距，需要一种鲁棒、与标记布局无关的方法。

Method: 核心思想是将无序标记观测映射到一组固定的"代理锚点"（含骨骼关节与体表点），作为稳定中间表征。先用循环滑动窗口架构对长序列的锚点进行初始化与跟踪；再用自定义可微 Gauss-Newton 求解器将 SMPL-H 模型拟合到跟踪到的锚点，恢复全身姿态、平移与体型。通过显式推导几何残差，求解器端到端学习自适应观测置信度、平滑度与先验权重，动态适应输入可靠性。

Result: 在多样含噪标记配置上的大量实验表明，DirtyMoCap 仅用单一训练模型即可泛化到任意布局，在关节与顶点重建精度上持续优于针对特定配置的 SOTA 基线；自定义 CUDA 求解器相比标准 PyTorch 实现最高实现 100 倍加速，并应用于异构原始光学动捕录制的传统中国武术数据，产出时间连贯的 SMPL-H Kung Fu 运动数据集。

Conclusion: DirtyMoCap 通过代理锚点中间表征与可微求解器，实现了布局无关、鲁棒的标记式动作捕捉重建，兼顾精度与效率，并提供代码、数据与武�术数据集。

Abstract: Optical motion capture delivers high-fidelity human motion, but its reliance on strict marker layouts and clean trajectories severely limits its real-world applicability. In practice, tracking systems frequently output unconstrained markers: sparse, noisy, and unordered point clouds with unknown or varying configurations. To bridge the gap between corrupted raw markers and parametric human models, we introduce DirtyMoCap, a robust, marker-layout-free framework. Our core insight is to map unordered marker observations to a fixed set of "proxy anchors" comprising skeletal joints and body surface points, which serve as a stable intermediate representation. We first initialize and track these anchors over long sequences using a recurrent sliding-window architecture. Then, a custom differentiable Gauss-Newton solver fits the SMPL-H model to the tracked anchors to recover full-body pose, translation, and shape. By explicitly deriving geometric residuals, our solver learns adaptive observation confidence, smoothness, and prior weights end-to-end, adapting dynamically to the reliability of the input data. Extensive experiments on diverse, noisy marker configurations demonstrate that DirtyMoCap successfully generalizes across arbitrary layouts using only a single trained model. It consistently outperforms state-of-the-art configuration-specific baselines in both joint and vertex reconstruction accuracy, while our custom CUDA solver achieves up to a 100x speedup over standard PyTorch implementations. We further apply DirtyMoCap to heterogeneous raw optical MoCap recordings of traditional Chinese martial arts, yielding a Kung Fu motion dataset of temporally coherent SMPL-H reconstructions. Code and data are available at https://wanglongzju.github.io/DirtyMoCap-Project-Page.

</details>


### [45] [Enhanced Knowledge Distillation for Detection Transformer via Teacher Prediction Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19964)
*Yitong Xing,Yuhao Cheng,Yanping Li,Yichao Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出即插即用的教师预测精炼蒸馏模块TPRD，通过正预测修正、负预测抑制和最大暗知识保留，提升DETR蒸馏监督质量，在MS COCO和PASCAL VOC上验证有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DETR检测性能强但计算开销大，难以部署到边缘设备；现有DETR蒸馏方法主要关注蒸馏点对齐，忽视了教师监督本身的质量。作者观察到DETR存在阶段式非单调预测行为：早期阶段定位准确或分类正确的预测在后期可能退化，部分负预测变得过度自信，导致仅依赖当前阶段预测产生不准确且不一致的监督。

Method: 提出TPRD（Teacher Prediction Refinement Distillation），一个即插即用模块，在蒸馏前利用各阶段预测信息精炼教师预测。包含三个组件：PPC（Positive Prediction Correction）通过回溯早期阶段恢复更准确的正预测，修正退化的正预测，保证可靠的定位与分类信号；NPS（Negative Prediction Suppression）抑制过度自信负预测的影响，防止其向学生提供误导监督；MDKP（Maximum Dark Knowledge Preservation）选择性精炼目标类logits，同时保留非目标类关系以保信息性暗知识。

Result: 在MS COCO和PASCAL VOC上的大量实验证明了方法的有效性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过精炼教师监督质量而非仅对齐蒸馏点，TPRD可有效提升DETR蒸馏效果，且具备即插即用与良好泛化性。

Abstract: Detection Transformers (DETRs) achieve strong performance in object detection but remain challenging to deploy on edge devices due to their high computational cost. Existing DETR distillation methods mainly focus on aligning distillation points, while largely overlooking the quality of the teacher's supervision itself. We observe that due to stage-wise non-monotonic prediction behavior in DETRs, well-localized or correctly classified predictions from earlier stages may degrade in later ones, and some negative predictions become increasingly overconfident. As a result, relying solely on the current stage's predictions yields inaccurate and inconsistent supervision. To address this issue, we propose Teacher Prediction Refinement Distillation (TPRD), a plug-and-play module that refines teacher predictions before distillation by exploiting stage-wise prediction information. TPRD improves supervision quality through Positive Prediction Correction (PPC), which corrects degraded positive predictions by restoring more accurate ones from earlier stages, ensuring reliable localization and classification signals, and Negative Prediction Suppression (NPS) suppresses the influence of overconfident negatives, preventing them from providing misleading supervision to the student. To preserve informative dark knowledge, we further introduce Maximum Dark Knowledge Preservation (MDKP), which selectively refines target-class logits while retaining non-target relations. Extensive experiments on MS COCO and PASCAL VOC demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method. Our code is available at https://github.com/xingyitong1/TPRD.

</details>


### [46] [Beyond the Foreground: FOV-Aware Polyp Image Synthesis via Lesion-Guided Adaptive Mucosal Context Propagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19966)
*Tong Wang,Yuting He,Bin Ren,Yutong Xie,Guanyu Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LAMP：一种基于病灶引导自适应黏膜上下文传播的前景引导息肉图像合成框架，通过FOV掩码分离病灶、有效黏膜与镜头外部区域，显式解决黑色非黏膜污染与局部推理导致的纹理光照不一致问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结肠镜标注稀缺，合成图像-掩码对可缓解该问题，但真实合成需在保留给定病灶的同时生成兼容黏膜。现有前景引导方法将所有非前景像素视为背景，且主要依赖局部整合，直接应用于结肠镜场景会产生两个问题：非黏膜黑色区域污染生成组织；局部推理导致黏膜纹理与光照不一致。

Method: 提出LAMP框架。使用视场（FOV）掩码显式分离病灶、有效黏膜与镜头外部区域。通过Lesion-to-Mucosa交叉注意力为有效黏膜位置提取病灶外观条件；采用FOV约束的多方向Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value（Vision RWKV）在合法组织支撑区域上传播这些条件；再由自适应门控机制控制其残差融合进入扩散U-Net。

Result: 在五个息肉数据集上的大量实验表明，LAMP在整体生成质量上显著优于现有方法，并一致提升五个下游分割模型的性能。

Conclusion: LAMP是首个基于病灶引导自适应黏膜上下文传播的前景引导息肉图像合成框架，验证了显式区分黏膜与镜头外区域、并结合全局多方向传播对结肠镜合成与下游分割的有效性；代码将开源于 https://github.com/wangtong627/LAMP。

Abstract: Synthetic image and mask pairs can alleviate scarce colonoscopy annotations, but realistic synthesis requires preserving the supplied lesion while generating compatible mucosa. Existing foreground-guided methods treat all non-foreground pixels as background and rely mainly on local integration. Directly applying them to colonoscopy causes two problems: non-mucosal black regions contaminate generated tissue, and local reasoning produces inconsistent mucosal texture and illumination. We propose LAMP, the first foreground-guided framework for polyp image synthesis based on lesion-guided adaptive mucosal context propagation. LAMP explicitly separates the lesion, valid mucosa, and camera exterior using a field-of-view (FOV) mask. Lesion-to-Mucosa cross-attention extracts lesion appearance conditions for valid-mucosa locations, while FOV-constrained multidirectional Vision Receptance Weighted Key Value propagates them over legal tissue support. An adaptive gate then controls their residual fusion into the diffusion U-Net. Extensive experiments on five polyp datasets demonstrate that LAMP substantially outperforms existing methods in overall generation quality and consistently improves five downstream segmentation models. Our code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/LAMP.

</details>


### [47] [An Event Preserving Velocity Invariant Representation for Event Cameras](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19973)
*Mikihiro Ikura,Luna Gava,Jiahang Wu,Chiara Bartolozzi,Arren Glover*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SCARF——一种面向事件相机的实时、速度不变的事件表示方法，保留原始事件并统一处理快速运动、静止场景与独立运动物体，在计算效率和表示质量上达到最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机虽具备低延迟、高时间分辨率的优势，但其异步、独立像素的电路特性带来新的算法挑战。现有的速度不变表示虽能缓解慢运动下的观测缺失和快运动下的运动模糊，但多数通过将事件转换为类图像表示，从而丢弃了时间信息。

Method: 提出SCARF（Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields，中心激活感受野集合），一种实时、速度不变的表示方法，直接保留原始事件，同时一致性地处理快速运动、静止场景以及独立运动物体。

Result: SCARF在计算效率与表示质量两方面均取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。

Conclusion: SCARF在保留事件时间信息的同时实现速度不变性，兼顾效率与质量，适用于机器人等实时视觉任务。

Abstract: Event cameras provide low-latency, high temporal resolution perception for real-time vision tasks such as robotics.The novel circuitry (i.e. asynchronous, independent pixels) that enables these advantages also introduces new algorithmic challenges. Velocity-invariant representations alleviate missing observations under slow motion and motion blur under fast motion, but most discard temporal information by converting events into image-like representations. We propose Set of Centre Active Receptive Fields (SCARF), a real-time velocity-invariant representation that preserves raw events while consistently handling fast motion, stationary scenes, and independently moving objects. SCARF achieves state-of-the-art performance in both computational efficiency and representation quality.

</details>


### [48] [QCPruner: Query-Conditioned Population Coverage for Visual Token Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19990)
*Shengli He,Yongchao Liang,Roumeng He,Junjie Zeng,Jiyuan He,Can Wu,Li Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 QCPruner：一种免训练的多模态大模型视觉 token 剪枝方法，通过对视觉目标与候选代表进行双边查询条件化效用加权，在子模覆盖框架下同时兼顾查询相关性与冗余抑制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大模型中视觉 token 负载过高，需免训练剪枝以减少后层计算；固定预算下剪枝须保留与查询相关的证据并避免冗余。现有方法仅对 token 排序、做子集多样化或优化覆盖率，却未使用统一的、以查询为条件的视觉效用同时加权“视觉目标”与“候选代表”两种角色。

Method: QCPruner 通过双边效用加权使两种角色均查询条件化：以关键词匹配得到查询锚点，融合两种跨模态线索形成效用，并将其同时施加于视觉目标与候选代表，嵌入基于视觉亲和力的覆盖度量中；所得非负设施选址目标具有单调性与子模性，保留标准 (1-1/e) 贪心近似保证，且无需模型训练或参数更新。

Result: 在 LLaVA-1.5、LLaVA-NeXT、LLaVA-Video 与 Qwen2.5-VL 上，QCPruner 在每个报告的 token 预算下均取得所评估完整系统剪枝方法中最高的平均相对性能。LLaVA-1.5-7B 上 576 取 32 token 时保留 96.1% 未剪枝性能（最强基线 93.9%）；Qwen2.5-VL-7B 上 1296 取 256 token 时分别为 96.7% 与 92.5%。

Conclusion: QCPruner 以双边查询条件化效用加权统一了“目标重要性”与“代表代表性”，在保持子模贪心理论保证与免训练特性的同时，跨多种 MLLM 与 token 预算稳定优于现有剪枝基线。

Abstract: The high visual-token load in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) motivates training-free pruning to reduce later-layer computation, but under a fixed budget, pruning must preserve query-relevant evidence while avoiding redundancy. Existing methods rank tokens, diversify selected subsets, or optimize coverage without using a shared per-visual query utility to weight both visual targets and candidate representatives. We introduce QCPruner, which makes both roles query-conditioned through bilateral utility weighting. Using keyword-matched query anchors, QCPruner fuses two cross-modal cues into utility and applies it to both visual targets and candidate representatives within visual-affinity-based coverage. The resulting nonnegative facility-location objective is monotone and submodular, retains the standard (1-1/e) greedy guarantee, and requires no model training or parameter updates. Across LLaVA-1.5, LLaVA-NeXT, LLaVA-Video, and Qwen2.5-VL, QCPruner achieves the highest average relative performance among evaluated complete-system pruning methods at every reported token budget. At 32 of 576 tokens on LLaVA-1.5-7B, it retains 96.1% of unpruned performance, versus 93.9% for the strongest evaluated baseline. At 256 of 1296 tokens on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, the corresponding values are 96.7% and 92.5%.

</details>


### [49] [AVTrace: Diagnosing Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning in Omni Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19991)
*Longyin Zhang,Parth Sakhare Mahendra,Chengwei Wei,Ning Zhang,Lim Ming Chong,Sirui He,Ai Ti Aw*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 AVTrace，一个面向全模态模型的音视频时序推理诊断基准，涵盖起止点定位、同步判断、链式解析等七类任务，含 34,114 条训练样本及 3,500/7,000 的验证与测试集。五个开源全模态模型在同步验证上均低于多数类基线 0.556，且在链式解析与事件条件化理解上表现较差；参数高效时序后训练可部分提升性能，但外部图像基准出现轻微退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有全模态模型虽能描述视频内容，但其时间定位、事件顺序保持和音视频同步判断能力尚未被系统检验。同时，基于语义参考文本重叠的评价指标可能被误当作时序定位能力的代理，缺乏专门诊断工具。

Method: 构建 AVTrace 银标准诊断套件，任务包括起始点与跨度定位、同步、下一步预测、跨模态定位、链式解析和事件条件化理解；提供 34,114 条训练样本，以及类别均衡的 3,500 验证和 7,000 测试样本。评估五种开源全模态模型，按各自输入配置，采用参考盲响应归一化后确定性打分；并对 Qwen3-Omni-30B 做开发集扰动分析，对 Gemma4-E4B-it 进行参数高效时序后训练，另在三个外部图像基准上检验迁移效果。

Result: 五个现成系统在同步验证上均低于测试集多数类基线 0.556，在链式解析、事件条件化定位与理解上得分较低。开发集扰动显示 Qwen3-Omni-30B 对模态移除和视觉输入处理变化存在任务相关敏感性，但未隔离原因。参数高效时序后训练在若干指标上提升 Gemma4-E4B-it；三个外部图像基准上任务指标变化不大且部分下降，同时教师强制困惑度降低。

Conclusion: 语义参考文本重叠不应被视为时序定位的代理指标。AVTrace 能识别任务特定弱点，并为时序后训练提供测试平台。

Abstract: Omni models can describe video content, but can they locate events in time, preserve event order, and judge audio-visual synchronization? We introduce AVTrace (Audio-Visual Temporal Reasoning Assessment and Capability Evaluation), a silver-standard diagnostic suite spanning onset and span grounding, synchronization, next-step prediction, cross-modal localization, chain parsing, and event-conditioned comprehension. It contains 34,114 training examples and category-balanced development and test splits of 3,500 and 7,000 examples. We evaluate five open omni models under their respective input configurations using reference-blind response normalization followed by deterministic scoring. All five off-the-shelf systems score below the test split's majority-label baseline of 0.556 on synchronization verification, and obtain low scores on chain parsing and event-conditioned grounding and comprehension. Development-set perturbations reveal task-dependent sensitivity in Qwen3-Omni-30B to modality removal and changes in visual input processing, without isolating their underlying causes. Parameter-efficient temporal post-training improves Gemma4-E4B-it on several benchmark metrics. On three external image benchmarks, task metrics change modestly, including some degradations, while teacher-forcing perplexity decreases. Together, these findings show that semantic reference-text overlap should not be treated as a proxy for temporal localization, and that AVTrace can identify task-specific weaknesses while providing a testbed for temporal post-training.

</details>


### [50] [GRF-Recon: Global Ray-Field Optimization for Long-Sequence Feed-forward Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20012)
*Enpeng Li,Yunzhou Zhang,Zhiyao Zhang,Dexuan Lyu,Chenyu Wang,Chiyuan Cui,Cheng Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出统一的前馈三维重建框架，通过由粗到细轨迹对齐、LoRA几何先验注入、混合权重稀疏光线场优化与轨迹拼接，实现长单目序列的稳定可扩展重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前馈三维重建在大规模单目场景中受限于GPU显存开销大、局部几何退化及长期轨迹漂移；现有分块（chunk-based）优化几何约束有限，难以在长轨迹上保持全局一致性。

Method: 采用由粗到细的轨迹对齐，并注入轻量几何先验；通过LoRA适配将单目几何线索蒸馏进前馈主干，在保持推理效率的同时提升细结构深度精度；提出混合权重稀疏光线场优化，利用高频几何特征引导局部点云细化并施加一致的帧间光线约束，建立强跨帧几何耦合；最后引入带联合光线误差优化的高效轨迹拼接策略，显式减少累积漂移。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法在轨迹精度上与代表性SLAM系统具有竞争力，并在大规模场景中保持全局一致的三维重建。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了可扩展的前馈重建与全局一致性优化，在长单目序列的大规模场景中兼顾精度与效率，为前馈三维重建的规模化应用提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction provides an efficient paradigm for scene modeling from image sequences. Scaling these models to large monocular scenarios are constrained by excessive GPU memory footprint, degraded local geometry, and long-term trajectory drift. Existing chunk-based optimization strategies provide limited geometric constraints and fail to maintain global consistency over extended trajectories. We present a unified framework for stable and scalable feed-forward 3D reconstruction from long monocular sequences. Our approach builds on coarse-to-fine trajectory alignment augmented by lightweight geometric prior injection. Distilling monocular geometric cues into the feed-forward backbone via LoRA adaptation improves depth accuracy on fine structures while preserving inference efficiency. We introduce a hybrid-weight sparse ray-field optimization that leverages high-frequency geometric features to guide local point-cloud refinement and enforce consistent inter-frame ray constraints. Unlike prior chunk-based methods, this establishes strong cross-frame geometric coupling while maintaining scalability. Finally, an efficient trajectory stitching strategy with joint ray-error optimization explicitly reduces accumulated drift. Extensive experiments show that our approach achieves competitive trajectory accuracy compared with representative SLAM systems, while maintaining globally consistent 3D reconstruction in large-scale scenarios.

</details>


### [51] [Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20034)
*Xin Zhou,Cong Miao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Astronex-World 1.0 是一个开放可控的视频世界模型基础模型，支持文本/图像到视频生成，并可接收相机轨迹、连续动作与具身标识等控制信号，包含双向与因果两条生成路径，5B 规模在多项基准上对标甚至超越更大模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建一个可控制、可扩展的视频世界模型基础，使模型能够在给定初始观测或文本提示下预测未来视觉状态，并为具身智能与自动驾驶等下游任务预留动作输入输出接口。

Method: 基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 先验，提供用于全上下文生成的双向模型和带块因果注意力及跨块 KV 缓存的因果模型；通过 PRoPE 注入相机内参和外参，并以 64 维动作流调制每个 Transformer 层；采用五阶段训练路径：双向相机与动作控制、骨干转块因果生成、少步学生蒸馏、混合域动力学恢复、非对称 DMD/DMD2 分布匹配。

Result: 因果模型以 24 fps 生成 832x480 视频；全部五阶段训练在两块 NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPU 上完成，因果模型可在单卡实时流式生成；在 WBench Navi 得分 73.5，WBench Full 得分 70.0，在 Full 上超过 13.6B 的 LongCat-Video 与 14B 的 Helios，与 22B 的 LTX-2.3 相差不到 1 分，并高于同基座的 YUME 1.5。

Conclusion: 该工作表明 5B 规模模型在高效训练与推理条件下即可实现较强的可控视频世界建模能力，并具备通过预留动作接口向具身智能和自动驾驶扩展的潜力。

Abstract: We present Astronex-World 1.0, an open controllable video world-model foundation. Given a text prompt (text-to-video) or an initial observation (image-to-video), the model predicts future visual states under frame-aligned camera trajectories, continuous actions, and an embodiment identifier, and accepts text events inserted at a specified position of a rollout. The family provides a bidirectional model for full-context generation and a causal model with block-causal attention and cross-block KV caching for persistent generation, both built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior. PRoPE injects camera intrinsics and extrinsics, while a 64-dimensional action stream modulates every Transformer layer. A five-stage training path develops bidirectional camera and action control, converts the backbone to block-causal generation, distills a few-step student, restores mixed-domain dynamics, and applies asymmetric DMD/DMD2 distribution matching. The causal model generates 832x480 video at 24 fps. All five training stages run on two NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPUs, and the causal model streams in real time on one. It scores 73.5 on WBench Navi and 70.0 on WBench Full. On Full, this 5B model is above the 13.6B LongCat-Video and the 14B Helios, within one point of the 22B LTX-2.3, and above YUME 1.5, which is post-trained from the same 5B prior on NVIDIA A100 GPUs. The reserved action input and output interfaces allow post-training for embodied intelligence and autonomous driving.

</details>


### [52] [A Free Lunch? Adapting PP-OCRv6 for Historical Text Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20064)
*Benjamin Kiessling*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究针对历史手写文本识别（ATR）中大型视觉语言模型成本高、依赖大规模预训练且存在幻觉的问题，评估了轻量级无循环识别器PP-OCRv6在历史文字行识别上的表现，并与传统CRNN及大型VLM（Medusa/Qwen3.5）进行对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉语言模型虽报告分数亮眼，但因计算开销大、依赖大规模预训练和幻觉问题，在历史自动文本识别中实际应用有限；历史ATR仍主要依赖紧凑的CRNN行识别器，因其视觉接地且可在中等规模数据上训练。轻量级无循环识别器有望兼顾大模型精度与CRNN实用性，但尚未在历史书写上被系统评估。

Method: 将近期紧凑型文本识别器PP-OCRv6（无强语言建模）适配于历史文字行识别，与传统CRNN在多语言拉丁与阿拉伯字母材料上进行比较，涵盖四类设置：通用预训练、领域特定训练、语料库级微调、手稿特定少样本适配；并与基于Qwen3.5的Medusa识别器进行对比。

Result: PP-OCRv6在从零训练时并未稳定超越CRNN基线；但异构预训练带来了显著更好的泛化能力。与Medusa识别器对比显示，经微调的PP-OCRv6可超越面向历史拉丁字母手写文本识别的大型VLM。

Abstract: Despite impressive reported scores, large vision-language models have seen limited practical uptake in historical automatic text recognition because of their computational cost, dependence on large-scale pretraining, and hallucination. Lightweight recurrence-free recognizers promise the accuracy of larger models with the practical advantages of CRNNs, yet have not been comprehensively evaluated on historical writing. ### [53] [PointEvent: Rethinking Event-based Tiny Object Detection via Serialized Motion Evidence Accumulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20066)
*Zongze Wu,Baofeng Jia,Weiqi Yan,Jingyuan Zhang,Yu Zang,Xiaoyu Chen,Jing Han*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PointEvent，将运动连续性建模为串行化证据累积过程，用事件级状态空间框架交替扫描互补序列，实现轻量、高精度的微小UAV检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 事件相机适合微小UAV检测，但远距离目标事件稀疏、碎片化，易被杂波和自运动淹没。现有方法依赖稠密事件表征或局部稀疏时空建模，导致冗余计算或跨异步事件运动连续性建模碎片化。
