We present SmellDiffusion, a simulation pipeline that represents species-specific gas zones in an open-vocabulary olfactory scene graph and shares the selected goal between classical and diffusion planners. Its key components are a peak-local geometric gate for selective source correction and diffusion-based, gas-guided trajectory generation. Among 424 unique source-wind configurations in solved flow, 28 have a concentration peak displaced more than 0.5m from the source. A source-independent geometric gate, calibrated only on the training split and evaluated at the observed peak, detects 9 of 10 held-out displacements at 0.64 precision. Gating a precomputed forward-matching correction reduces mean error on the displaced cases from 1.468m to 0.592m (60%), using matching for only 14/204 cases. All-case mean error falls from 0.205m to 0.180m. All planners receive the same scene-graph source estimate as their goal. In a controlled comparison, best-of-ten diffusion achieves mean gas exposure comparable to gas-guided A* (0.0476 versus 0.0455). A single diffusion proposal takes 41.7ms, compared with 72.3ms for gas-guided A*, although best-of-ten sequential sampling increases total runtime. Plain A* also reaches the same goal and remains the fastest and shortest-path method. Six matched Gazebo runs give mean robot-to-source errors of 0.39m for A* and 0.31m for diffusion.

</details>


### [302] [RTK-Vision PPO for Autonomous Micro UAV Recovery on an Airborne Carrier](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20629)
*Aashish Sahu,R Prasanth Kumar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RTK-视觉引导的强化学习框架，实现小型无人机自主降落到移动空中载具并完成完整的"起飞—任务—返回—再对接—随载具降落"循环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复用"部署—任务—回收"作业需要无人机自主返回移动空中载具，但该过程耦合了远距离引导、近距离感知、载具运动、气动干扰与不连续接触事件，难度大；已有工作多只研究孤立降落动作，缺乏完整闭环。

Method: 子机由大型载具携载并在空中起飞执行独立任务，返回载具当前位置再对接并随之降落。两机均配备RTK-GNSS，载具持续共享导航状态；近回收平台时RTK保持工作，下视相机配合基准标记检测器提供相对对齐信息。终端回收阶段用PPO策略，在基于物理的MuJoCo仿真中训练，并引入显式传感器噪声模型、气动干扰代理模型和标记延迟随机化，再迁移至硬件；PX4负责底层稳定，确定性安全门独立于学习策略授权下降。

Result: PPO模型在2000个随机化终端回合中成功率99.55%，相同条件下调优PD基线为78.4%，平面终端误差中位数6.62 cm；14次户外试验中完整任务成功13次（92.9%），覆盖近区回收与载具远离释放点后的回收。

Conclusion: 实现了完整的自主空中部署—回收循环，而非孤立的降落机动，为巡检、监视与移动物流等场景中的可复用"载具—子机"作业提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Autonomous recovery of a micro unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) onto a moving airborne carrier enables reusable deploy-mission-recover operation, but couples long-range rendezvous, close-range perception, carrier motion, aerodynamic interaction, and a discontinuous contact event. This paper presents an RTK-vision-guided reinforcement-learning framework in which a child UAV is physically transported by a larger carrier, takes off from the carrier while airborne, executes an independent sortie, returns to the carrier's current position, redocks, and subsequently descends with the carrier. Both vehicles carry RTK-GNSS, and the carrier continuously shares its navigation state with the child. Near the recovery deck, RTK remains active while a downward-facing camera with a fiducial marker detector provides marker-relative alignment cues. A proximal policy optimization (PPO) policy governing the terminal recovery phase is trained in a physics-based MuJoCo simulation environment with explicit sensor noise models, an aerodynamic disturbance surrogate, and marker-latency randomization, then transferred to hardware. PX4 retains low-level stabilization, and a deterministic safety gate authorizes descent independently of the learned policy. The PPO checkpoint achieves 99.55% success over 2,000 held-out randomized terminal episodes, compared with 78.4% for a tuned PD baseline under identical conditions, with a median planar terminal error of 6.62 cm. Across 14 outdoor trials, the full mission succeeds in 13 trials (92.9%), spanning both near-region recovery and recovery after the carrier translates away from the release point. The results demonstrate a complete autonomous aerial deployment-and-recovery cycle rather than an isolated landing maneuver, establishing a practical basis for reusable carrier-child operation in inspection, surveillance, and mobile-logistics applications.

</details>


### [303] [TraceFlow: Guiding Frozen Flow-Matching Robot Policies with Success and Failure Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20646)
*Jiaxuan Zhang,Ruizhe Liu,Yu Zhang,Yanchao Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TraceFlow 提出一种进度对齐的引导场，用成功/失败回放的 action 密度对冻结的 flow-matching 动作专家做有界修正，仅依赖每次回放的终端成败比特，在真机与仿真任务上提升成功率并消除错误序列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有测试时方法（检索成功样例、学习 critic、验证器、动力学模型）为冻结策略提供额外输入，但均未把机器人自身失败回放作为负证据使用，且无法只凭一个终端成败比特加以利用。

Method: 构造进度对齐引导场，将检索到的成功与失败回放的 action 密度转化为对冻结 flow-matching 动作专家的有界修正；仅使用每次回放的单一终端结果比特，无其他标签。建立 TraceBank，存储带终端标签的时序 state-action 记录，初始来自目标任务训练轨迹，后续接纳部署机器人自身回放。

Result: 真机有序装箱任务：基础策略 50 次按序完成 21 次，TraceFlow 39 次，无权重更新的一轮堆叠达 47 次，错误序列从 20 降至 0。仿真中增益具选择性：按套件选参后，RoboMemArena Sequence 任务成功率由 78.92% 升至 91.50%，Transferring 在第 2 轮堆叠由 54.41% 升至 62.00%；26 任务总体持平，Counting 与 Occlusion 分别降 1.12 和 1.42 点，LIBERO-Plus（Long）+1.27 点（p = 0.0733）。堆叠增益有限，各分支在第 10 轮前达峰，且 bank 的成功-失败比无法预测检索分配。

Conclusion: 仅凭终端成败比特即可将失败回放转化为有效的测试时引导信号，提升序列与迁移任务表现并抑制错误序列，但增益有界且具任务选择性，成功-失败比对检索分配无预测力。

Abstract: A vision-language-action (VLA) policy with a flow-matching action expert generates each action chunk (a short command sequence) by integrating a learned velocity field; once its weights are fixed, the success or failure of an earlier rollout cannot change the chunk generated now. Concurrent test-time methods give a frozen policy such an input from retrieved successes, a learned critic, a verifier, or a dynamics model, but none uses the robot's own failed rollouts as negative evidence with nothing but a terminal outcome bit. We introduce TraceFlow, a progress-aligned guidance field that turns the action densities of retrieved successful and failed rollouts into a bounded correction to a frozen flow-matching action expert, using one terminal outcome bit per rollout and no other label. Its TraceBank stores traces, time-ordered state-action records with a terminal label, starts from the target-task training traces, and later admits the deployed robot's own rollouts. On an ordered real-robot packing task the base completes 21 of 50 trials in order, TraceFlow 39, and one stacking round without any weight update 47, with wrong-sequence episodes falling from 20 to 0. In simulation the gain is selective: with per-suite selected settings, TraceFlow raises RoboMemArena Sequence from 78.92\% to 91.50\% task success and Transferring from 54.41\% to 62.00\% at stacking round 2, leaves the 26-task aggregate unchanged, lowers Counting and Occlusion by 1.12 and 1.42 points, and changes LIBERO-Plus (Long) by +1.27 points (p = 0.0733). Stacking gains are finite, every branch peaking before round ten, and the bank's success-to-failure ratio predicts no retrieval allocation.

</details>


### [304] [SkipVLA: Skipping VLA Steps with Classical Planning for Fast Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20648)
*Kaivalya Agrawal,Md Ashiqur Rahman,Raymond A. Yeh,Zachary Kingston*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SkipVLA将预训练VLA与经典运动规划器组合，仅对抓取/放置等接触密集型技能查询VLA，自由空间运动交由规划器完成，实现最高2.5倍加速与更低能耗且成功率不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽通用但推理缓慢，长时程任务需大量策略查询导致延迟高；现有蒸馏、异步动作块、低层快策略等方法仍需在整段任务上运行学习策略。经典运动规划器能快速生成无碰撞运动，但缺乏语义理解且需要显式目标。

Method: 提出混合策略SkipVLA：用经典运动规划器负责自由空间运动，仅在接触密集型技能（抓取、放置）时查询VLA。复用VLA的冻结视觉-语言主干预测每个规划运动的目标位姿，并在不引入新示范数据的情况下，利用大VLA已有知识训练该位姿预测器。

Result: 在仿真中对3种VLA、13个LIBERO任务进行评估，并在物理6-DoF YAM机械臂上完成3个抓放任务；任务完成速度最高提升2.5倍，能耗显著降低，同时保持相同的任务成功率。

Conclusion: 将VLA的语义推理能力与经典规划器的高效运动生成相结合，可在不牺牲成功率的前提下显著降低VLA策略的推理延迟与能耗，为长时程机器人任务提供实用加速方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are a class of generalist robot policies that map camera images and language instructions directly to robot actions. While promising, these models remain slow at test time, particularly for long-horizon tasks that require many queries to the policy. Recent efforts reduce VLA latency by distilling smaller models, overlapping asynchronous action chunks, or pairing the VLA with a fast low-level policy, but still run a learned policy for the entire task. In contrast to VLA, classical motion planners quickly find collision-free motions, but require an explicit goal and have no semantic understanding of the task. In this work, we present SkipVLA, a hybrid policy that combines a pretrained VLA with a classical motion planner, using the planner for free-space motion and querying the VLA only for contact-rich skills such as grasping and placing. SkipVLA reuses the frozen vision-language backbone of the VLA to predict a target pose for each planned motion, and learns this predictor without additional demonstrations introduced into the system by using what was already learnt by the large VLA. We evaluate SkipVLA with three VLAs on 13 LIBERO tasks in simulation and three pick-and-place tasks on a physical 6-DoF YAM arm, demonstrating up to 2.5x faster task completion and significantly lower energy consumption while achieving the same task success rate.

</details>


### [305] [HIL-UMI: Bringing Human-in-the-Loop Post-Training of Vision-Language-Action Models to Universal Manipulation Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20659)
*Zimu Han,Yiming Zeng,Jiyao Zhang,Zihao Zhao,Yuanfei Wang,Yixiang Jin,Shiqi Li,Shuangben Chen,Wei Huang,Ruodai Li,Hui Shen,Hao Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 HIL-UMI，一个无需真实机器人、基于通用操作接口（UMI）的人在回路 VLA 后训练框架，通过能量分数触发数据采集与优势估计器精炼，实现策略感知的迭代式后训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽有强先验，但适配具体部署仍困难。任务特定演示上的监督微调（SFT）存在两点局限：静态数据对分布外状态覆盖不足，且标准模仿目标无法区分推进性行为与低价值数据。交互式后训练可缓解该问题，但通常需在真实机器人上反复执行策略并依赖人工干预，成本高、难扩展。

Method: HIL-UMI 在手持 UMI 演示过程中，将当前策略在相同观测流上做推理但不执行其预测。用 Energy Score 比较人类动作轨迹与策略推理结果，当二者差异表明处于分布外区域时触发数据采集。另一反馈回路用低在线优势预测识别关键片段，用于精炼基于进展的优势估计器；更新后的估计器以基础演示与新策略数据的平衡混合，指导优势条件行为克隆（advantage-conditioned BC）。该设计将数据采集与机器人部署解耦，同时保留人在回路学习的迭代性与策略感知特性。

Result: 在四个真实世界任务（涵盖长时序与精细操作）上，HIL-UMI 相较 SFT 取得一致提升，并从定向采集与优势精炼两方面获益。在 Clean Up Table 任务上，HIL-UMI 优于 HG-DAgger，且每帧采集时间更低，表明其是可跨操作者与地点扩展的 VLA 后训练路径。

Conclusion: HIL-UMI 通过策略引导的无机器人人在回路机制，解决了 VLA 后训练中分布覆盖与数据价值区分的问题，验证了其有效性、效率与可扩展性，为 VLA 后训练提供了一条无需真实机器人执行的可扩展方案。

Abstract: Large-scale vision-language-action (VLA) models provide powerful priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them to a specific deployment remains challenging. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on task-specific demonstrations provides a step toward deployment, but faces two persistent limitations: static data provide limited coverage of out-of-distribution states, and standard imitation objectives do not distinguish progressing behavior from less useful data. Interactive post-training can address these limitations, but typically requires repeated policy execution and human intervention on a physical robot. We introduce HIL-UMI, a policy-guided Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) framework for robot-free human-in-the-loop VLA post-training. During handheld UMI demonstrations, HIL-UMI queries the current policy on the same observation stream without executing its predictions. The Energy Score compares the human action trajectory with policy inference and triggers collection when their discrepancy indicates an out-of-distribution region. In a separate feedback loop, low online advantage predictions identify essential segments for refining a progress-based advantage estimator. The updated estimator then guides advantage-conditioned behavioral cloning using a balanced mixture of base demonstrations and new policy data. This design preserves the iterative and policy-aware nature of human-in-the-loop learning while decoupling data collection from robot deployment. Experiments on four real-world tasks spanning long-horizon and precise manipulation show that HIL-UMI achieves consistent improvement over SFT and benefits from both targeted collection and advantage refinement. Moreover, HIL-UMI outperforms HG-DAgger on Clean Up Table with lower per-frame collection time, suggesting a scalable path for VLA post-training across operators and locations.

</details>


### [306] [MAGNETAR: Multipath-Guided Spatial Posteriors for Transmitter Pose Inference in the Upper Mid-Band](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20670)
*Haozhe Lei,Ruibin Chen,Yuhan Jiang,Ali Rasteh,Aditya Dhananjay,Sundeep Rangan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 MAGNETAR，一种从单次异步射频多径快照（含到达角和信噪比估计）中，联合推断平面发射机位置与朝向后验概率的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人定位射频发射机时，仅给出点估计不足：在杂乱房间中，一次测量常与多个发射机位置一致；且由于中高频段天线具有方向性，还会与多个朝向一致，因此需要位置—朝向的联合后验。

Method: MAGNETAR 在已知房间布局与接收机位姿条件下，采用共享 2D U-Net，并以每个候选朝向为条件，对离散化的位置—朝向网格上的得分进行联合归一化（共评估五种神经评分器）。训练使用经真实到仿真标定的 10 GHz 仿真数据及少量实测子集。

Result: 在留出仿真上，基于网格的联合后验优于参数化后验；以朝向为条件的评分器向机器人实测的迁移效果最佳；融合联合后验优于融合仅位置边缘后验。

Conclusion: 结果表明，建模位置—朝向的联合后验、并采用网格化与朝向条件化设计，能有效提升单快照射频定位在杂乱环境中的鲁棒性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Robots that localize a radio transmitter need more than a point estimate: in cluttered rooms, one measurement is often consistent with several transmitter locations and, because upper-mid-band antennas are directional, several headings. We present MAGNETAR, which infers a joint posterior over planar transmitter position and heading from a single asynchronous radio-frequency (RF) multipath snapshot, represented by angle-of-arrival and signal-to-noise-ratio estimates, given the room layout and receiver pose. Among our five neural scorers, MAGNETAR adopts a shared 2D U-Net conditioned on each candidate heading, jointly normalizing scores over a discretized position-heading grid. Training uses real-to-sim-calibrated 10 GHz simulations and a small measured subset. Grid-based joint posteriors outperform parametric ones on held-out simulations, the heading-conditioned scorer transfers best to robotic measurements, and fusing joint posteriors improves on fusing position-only marginals.

</details>


### [307] [Custom PX4 firmware for autonomous hybrid aerial-marine missions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20691)
*Andrea Capuozzo,Fabio Ruggiero,Vincenzo Lippiello*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种 PX4 固件扩展，为混合型空中-水面两栖无人机增加手动与自主水面航行模式，并整合到 PX4 任务流程与 QGroundControl 界面中，实现飞行与水面航行的统一任务规划，仿真验证了平静与波浪条件下的稳定水面导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水环境测绘与监测需要能在同一任务中兼顾飞行与水面航行的混合型两栖无人机，但现有 PX4 飞控框架缺乏对水面航行模式及其任务规划的支持，难以实现统一的混合任务执行。

Method: 对 PX4 固件进行扩展：新增手动与自主水面航行模式，并将其接入标准 PX4 任务（mission）流水线与 QGroundControl 地面站界面；在保留原有飞行功能与安全机制的前提下，支持区分空中航点与水面航点的统一规划与执行。通过仿真案例进行验证。

Result: 仿真案例研究验证了该实现的有效性，并表明平台在平静与波浪条件下均能实现稳定的水面导航。

Conclusion: 该 PX4 固件扩展以较低侵入性的方式为两栖无人机提供了统一的空中-水面任务能力，兼容既有飞控生态，为未来水环境空中-水面协同测绘与监测任务提供了可行的软硬件框架基础。

Abstract: Mapping and monitoring aquatic environments can benefit from hybrid aerial-amphibious drones able to combine flight and water-surface navigation within the same mission. This paper presents a PX4 firmware extension for such platforms, introducing manual and autonomous marine navigation modes integrated with the standard PX4 mission pipeline and QGroundControl interface. The proposed framework preserves existing flight functionalities and safety mechanisms while enabling unified planning and execution of hybrid aerial-marine missions with differentiated aerial and marine waypoints. Simulated case studies validate the implementation and demonstrate stable surface navigation under calm and wavy conditions.

</details>


### [308] [HOPHY: A Hierarchical Hypergraph Representation for Off-Road Path and Mission Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20694)
*Pranay Meshram,Charuvahan Adhivarahan,Prithvi Poddar,Ehsan Tarkesh Esfahani,Chen Wang,Souma Chowdhury,Karthik Dantu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HOPHY是一种可复用的分层越野规划表示，将地图尺度地形组织为几何连通语义区域、连通性保持的粗区域及带类型的超边，支持在不重建层次结构的情况下进行状态更新，实现高成功率、低延迟的重复路径与任务规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灾害响应、搜救和战术UGV任务需要在地形、智能体类型和目标变化时反复进行路径与任务规划。像素网格搜索在公里级重复查询中代价高，而语义抽象又必须在地形条件变化时维持有效的代价与连通性。

Method: 提出HOPHY分层越野规划方法：利用超图组织地图尺度地形，包含几何连通语义节点（GSNodes）、保持连通性的关键粗区域（Coarse Regions），以及用于表达地形、智能体和天气上下文的带类型超边；通过超边交集选择受影响区域与关联边进行状态更新，无需重建整个层次结构。

Result: 在公里级真实越野地图上，HOPHY达到100%规划成功率，相对像素A* oracle的中位代价偏差小于0.01%，查询与重规划延迟显著低于像素和抽象基线。应用于多机器人任务分配问题时，总计算量相比像素A*减少79倍，相比最快抽象基线减少7.2倍，任务完工时间与像素A*相当。并在Clearpath Jackal实体机器人上完成1.5公里、八任务混合地表任务及阻塞触发重规划路线。

Conclusion: HOPHY通过分层超图语义抽象与增量状态更新，在保持接近像素级最优性的同时大幅降低重复规划计算开销，适用于多机器人大规模越野任务，并具备实体机器人部署可行性。

Abstract: Mission-level autonomy for disaster response, search and rescue, and tactical UGV operations requires repeated path and mission planning as terrain conditions, agent types, and objectives change. Pixel-grid search is costly for repeated kilometer-scale queries, while semantic abstractions must maintain valid costs and connectivity as conditions change. We present HOPHY (Hierarchical Off-Road Planning using Hypergraphs), a reusable hierarchical terrain representation that organizes map-scale terrain into geometrically connected semantic regions (GSNodes), connectivity-preserving critical regions (Coarse Regions), and typed hyperedges for terrain, agent, and weather context. Hyperedge intersections select affected regions and incident edges for state updates without rebuilding the hierarchy. Across real off-road maps spanning kilometer-scale areas, HOPHY achieves 100% planning success and less than 0.01% median cost deviation from the oracle (pixel A*), with substantially lower query and replanning latency than the evaluated pixel and abstraction baselines. Applied to a multi-robot task-allocation (MRTA) problem, these gains reduce total computation by 79x over pixel A* and 7.2x over the fastest abstraction baseline, with mission makespan comparable to pixel A*. Finally, we demonstrate HOPHY on a physical Clearpath Jackal that successfully executes a 1.5-km, eight-task mission across mixed-surface outdoor terrain and a blockage-triggered replanned route.

</details>


### [309] [MoWAM: Explicit Future Motion Prediction for Efficient World Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20709)
*Jiayu Wang,Bin Zhu,Yue Yu,Jingjing Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MoWAM 用显式未来运动预测替代未来视频生成，在推理时完全去除视频生成，保持显式未来表征，并通过运动感知验证器实现高效的推理时扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 World Action Models 通过引入未来动力学提升机器人策略学习，但推理时显式生成未来视频计算开销大；若去除未来生成虽提升效率，却使未来动力学仅隐式编码在观测特征中，在分布偏移下鲁棒性受限。

Method: 提出 MoWAM，以显式未来运动预测替代未来视频生成：不再重建完整未来场景，而是将结构化机器人运动建模为未来的紧凑抽象，刻画在当前场景与交互约束下机器人预期的演化。采用 Mixture-of-Transformer 架构，训练时学习未来视觉动力学并联合预测运动与动作，推理时完全去除视频生成但保留显式未来表征。紧凑运动表示还支持推理时扩展：采样多个运动-动作候选对，用运动感知的任务进度验证器进行选择。

Result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 及真实世界操作任务上，MoWAM 取得强分布内性能、更优的分布外鲁棒性，以及高于代表性 WAM 基线的真实世界平均成功率；且随候选数量增加性能持续提升。

Conclusion: 显式未来运动是有效且高效的推理时扩展基础，MoWAM 在保持效率的同时兼顾了显式未来表征与鲁棒性。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) improve robot policy learning by incorporating future dynamics, yet explicitly generating future videos at inference introduces substantial computational overhead. Removing future generation improves efficiency, but leaves future dynamics only implicitly encoded in observation features, which can limit robustness under distribution shifts. We propose MoWAM, an efficient WAM that replaces future video generation with explicit future motion prediction. Instead of reconstructing the complete future scene, MoWAM models structured robot motion as a compact abstraction of the future, capturing how the robot is expected to evolve under the current scene and interaction constraints. A Mixture-of-Transformer architecture learns future visual dynamics during training while jointly predicting motion and action, allowing video generation to be removed entirely at inference while retaining an explicit representation of the future. The compact motion representation further enables efficient inference-time scaling by sampling multiple candidates of motion and action pairs and selecting among them with a motion-aware task-progress verifier. Experiments on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate that MoWAM achieves strong in-distribution performance, improved out-of-distribution robustness, and higher average real-world success than representative WAM baselines. In addition, performance improves as more candidates are explored, demonstrating that explicit future motion provides an effective and efficient basis for inference-time scaling.

</details>


### [310] [Underwater Visual Target Tracking with Target-Specific Depth Estimation and Adaptive Model-Fusion Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20731)
*Yuheng Zhou,Haiyang Cheng,Yanqi Feng,Pangkit Fong,Mei Xuan Lee,Marcus Gee,Chongrong Fang,Jianping He*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向AUV的立体视觉伺服框架：感知端通过目标深度掩膜与卡尔曼滤波获得稳定3D相对状态，控制端解耦偏航与平移并采用自适应模型融合MPC，仿真与实机实验验证其优于现有框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉水下目标跟踪面临深度测量不可靠与目标运动未知两大难题，现有框架难以同时保证状态估计稳定性与实时控制性能。

Method: 感知：由颜色、视差与时间线索构建目标深度掩膜，筛选可靠目标像素，分别对深度测量与图像中心做卡尔曼滤波，得到稳定3D相对状态。控制：解耦偏航调节与平移控制，规避高计算量的耦合多自由度优化，实现实时平移MPC；平移控制器采用自适应模型融合预测控制，融合恒速与零速目标模型，依据历史预测误差更新模型权重，并在执行器、跟随距离与视场约束下求解平移指令。

Result: 通过仿真与真实环境实验验证了框架有效性，性能优于现有框架。

Conclusion: 该立体视觉伺服框架通过可靠深度提取与模型融合自适应MPC，有效应对深度不可靠和未知目标运动，实现实时AUV水下目标跟踪。

Abstract: Vision-based underwater target tracking is challenged by unreliable depth measurements and unknown target motion. This paper proposes a stereo visual-servoing framework for an autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV). For perception, the framework derives a stable 3D relative state from stereo images through target-specific depth extraction and Kalman filtering. It constructs a target-depth mask from color, disparity, and temporal cues to select reliable target pixels, and then filters the resulting depth measurement and detected image center separately. For control, the framework decouples yaw regulation from translational control, avoiding computationally expensive coupled multi-DOF optimization and enabling real-time translational MPC. The translational controller employs adaptive model-fusion predictive control, combining constant-velocity and zero-velocity target models to accommodate different target-motion patterns. It updates the model weights using historical prediction errors and computes translational commands subject to actuation, following-distance, and field-of-view constraints. Through simulations and real-world experiments, we validate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and show it has better performance than existing frameworks.

</details>


### [311] [MILER: Semantic Mid-Level Representation for Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning in Unstructured Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20747)
*Thomas Steinecker,Denis Trescher,Alexander Bienemann,Thorsten Luettel,Mirko Maehlisch*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MILER是一个端到端策略框架，通过语义中层表示模拟器离线强化学习训练，并结合BEVFusion感知与轨迹对齐策略，实现非结构化环境下自动驾驶的零样本仿真到现实迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习虽具超人类性能与自学习策略潜力，但在真实世界自动驾驶中应用稀少，尤其是在非结构化环境下，主要瓶颈在于仿真到现实（sim-to-real）的迁移困难。

Method: 离线训练阶段，采用定制的语义中层表示（MLR）模拟器，用强化学习训练策略网络，控制输出直接作用于自行车模型。部署阶段，用BEVFusion处理相机与LiDAR数据，生成与MLR模拟器一致的语义鸟瞰图表征；策略网络产生的动作不直接作用于真实车辆，而是采用轨迹对齐策略实现感知与控制的零样本仿真到现实迁移。

Result: 在包含多种障碍物、发夹弯、最高33.6 km/h速度及越野路段的多样测试道上评估；两辆不同车辆在3.0 km测试道上共行驶17.3 km，全程无人工干预，验证了方法有效性；整个软件栈运行于Jetson AGX Orin。

Conclusion: MILER通过语义中层表示与轨迹对齐策略，成功实现非结构化环境下感知与控制的零样本仿真到现实迁移，并在真实车辆长距离自主行驶中得到验证，且整套系统可在嵌入式平台上运行。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning constitutes a promising approach owing to its potential for superhuman performance and self-learned policies. However, its application to real-world autonomous driving remains scarce, particularly in unstructured environments, because of the challenges associated with sim-to-real transfer for unstructured environments. In this work, we present MILER, an end-to-end policy framework with zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. During offline training, we employ a custom semantic mid-level representation (MLR) simulator and train the policy network using reinforcement learning, with its control outputs applied directly to a bicycle model. During deployment on the real vehicle, camera and LiDAR data are processed by BEVFusion to generate a semantic bird's-eye-view representation consistent with that of the MLR simulator. The actions generated by the policy network are not applied directly to the real vehicle. Instead, we employ a trajectory-alignment strategy that enables zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of both perception and control. We extensively evaluate the proposed framework on a diverse test track comprising numerous challenges, including various obstacles, hairpin curves, velocities of up to 33.6 km/h, and off-road sections. In total, we drove 17.3 km with two different vehicles on a 3.0 km test track without human intervention, thereby demonstrating the effectiveness of our approach. Furthermore, the entire software stack runs on a Jetson AGX Orin.

</details>


### [312] [Agile-WAM: An Agile Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20761)
*Hanchu Zhou,Brendan Lynch,Raman Goyal,Dechen Gao,Begum Kasap,Boqi Zhao,Junshan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种敏捷的触觉世界动作模型（WAM），通过共享潜空间与直接视觉-触觉到动作的流匹配，并引入多时序多模态预测，实现高成功率、低延迟的接触丰富型机器人控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期触觉WAM多依赖大规模预训练生成式骨干网络来建模接触丰富的物理动力学，导致推理效率低、部署不灵活。作者希望在不牺牲性能的前提下实现敏捷、可灵活部署的触觉世界动作模型。

Method: 将视觉与触觉观测编码到共享潜空间，作为直接"视觉-触觉到动作"流匹配过程的源；该过程联合生成动作块潜表示与未来视觉/触觉潜表示。基于视觉与触觉信号演化时间尺度不同的观察（相邻视觉帧高度相似，触觉信号在接触时突变），引入多时序多模态预测：以更大时间偏移监督视觉潜表示，同时预测下一帧触觉潜表示以捕捉细粒度接触动力学。

Result: 在9个仿真与5个真实世界接触丰富型操作任务上表现强劲且鲁棒，成功率超过最强基线且保持低推理延迟；5个真实世界实验中总体成功率相对提升29.4%，推理延迟为11.9 ms。

Conclusion: 结果表明多模态WAM可以借助敏捷架构实现，适用于精确、高频的机器人控制。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) advance beyond conventional visuomotor policies by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions, enabling the policy to learn physical dynamics that support effective control. However, recent tactile WAMs often rely on large-scale pretrained generative backbones to capture contact-rich physical dynamics, which limit their inference efficiency and flexible deployment. In this paper, we present \ABBR{}, an agile tactile World Action Model for contact-rich robot control. \ABBR{} encodes visual and tactile observations into a shared latent that serves as the source of a direct vision-tactile-to-action flow-matching process, which can jointly generate latent representations of action chunks and future visual/tactile latents. A key observation is that vision and tactile signals evolve at inherently different timescales: adjacent visual frames are often highly similar, whereas tactile signals can change abruptly upon contact. We therefore introduce multi-horizon multimodal prediction in \ABBR{}, which provides supervision for visual latent at a larger temporal offset while predicting the tactile latent in the next frame to capture fine-grained contact dynamics. Across nine simulated and five real-world contact-rich manipulation tasks, \ABBR{} demonstrates strong and robust performance, outperforming the strongest baseline in success rate while maintaining low inference latency. In particular, in five real-world experiments, \ABBR{} yields a relative gain of $\textbf{29.4\%}$ in overall success rates while achieving inference latency of $\textbf{11.9 ms}$. These results demonstrate that multimodal WAM can be achieved with an agile architecture suitable for precise and high-frequency robot control. More details are available on our project page: https://hanchuzhou.github.io/TARO_project_page/.

</details>


### [313] [GeoAAC: Geometry-Based Adaptive Action Chunking from Denoising Trajectories in VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20776)
*Xin Chen,Sen Chen,Yujuan Ding,Jian Liu,Guoqing Wang,Wei Ye,Heng Tao Shen,Yi Bin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GeoAAC是一种基于几何信息的自适应动作分块（action chunking）方法，用于流匹配（Flow Matching）VLA策略，通过Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何特征来表征预测可靠性，从而在单次生成中自适应确定动作视野（horizon），无需额外训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA策略在动作生成与执行中普遍采用固定动作视野（fixed action horizon），但在一次rollout中，不同任务阶段对动作连续性、控制精度和闭环反馈的需求不同，固定视野无法适应变化的控制需求。

Method: GeoAAC利用Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何信息作为过程级可靠性信号，发现动作前缀（action prefix）间的几何变化与预测不确定性正相关。基于此，GeoAAC利用前缀级几何构建视野级几何轮廓（horizon-wise geometric profile），在单次生成中自适应确定动作视野，且无需额外训练。

Result: 在GR00T N1.5和π0.5模型上，于LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、RoboCasa365及真实世界操作任务中验证，GeoAAC持续优于固定动作视野基线和现有自适应方法，仿真中最高提升8.7个百分点，真实世界平均成功率从53.3%提升至74.4%。

Conclusion: GeoAAC表明Flow Matching去噪轨迹的几何结构可作为有效的预测可靠性指标，实现无需训练、单次生成的自适应动作分块，在仿真与真实场景中均显著提升VLA策略性能。

Abstract: Action chunking is widely used for action generation and execution in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, yet existing approaches commonly use a fixed action horizon. During a rollout, different task stages may require different levels of action continuity, control precision, and closed-loop feedback, making a fixed horizon unable to accommodate changing control requirements. We propose \textbf{GeoAAC}, a geometry-based adaptive action chunking method for flow-based VLA policies that adjusts the action horizon according to the reliability of the current action prediction. We show that the geometry of Flow Matching denoising trajectories provides process-level information for characterizing prediction reliability, with geometric variation across action prefixes remaining positively correlated with predictive uncertainty. GeoAAC uses this prefix-wise geometry to construct a horizon-wise geometric profile and adaptively determine the action horizon from a single generation without additional training. Experiments with GR00T N1.5 and π0.5 on LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, RoboCasa365, and real-world manipulation tasks show consistent improvements over fixed-action-horizon baselines and existing adaptive methods, including up to 8.7 percentage points in simulation and an increase in average real-world success rate from 53.3\% to 74.4\%.

</details>


### [314] [StageGuard: Learning Stage Transitions for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks via Agentic Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20791)
*Jinbang Huang,Yuanzhao Hu,Zhiyuan Li,Ran Qi,Yixin Xiao,Yangzheng Wu,Tengyue Ba,Zhanguang Zhang,Yingxue Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出StageGuard，一种智能体蒸馏框架，通过教师模型推理与演示轨迹生成结构化解释，训练轻量学生VLM生成简洁自解释，实现分层机器人规划中准确高效的阶段转换决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分层规划框架需在长时程任务中判断何时终止当前技能并推进到下一子任务，但现有的完成信号检查器难以在真实执行中获取；大规模VLM虽推理能力强，但其决策边界与任务完成标准不对齐，且云端部署与长推理带来显著延迟，限制实时监控。

Method: StageGuard将教师模型推理与演示轨迹结合，生成子任务完成与策略切换的结构化解释；轻量学生VLM利用这些解释生成紧凑的自解释，并据此进行监督微调。

Result: 在两个基准的轨迹上进行阶段转换预测评估，并在BEHAVIOR-1K上通过集成到分层机器人控制评估闭环任务成功率，且进一步在真实机器人上验证；结果显示阶段转换预测显著提升，同时支持高效的在线监控。

Conclusion: StageGuard通过智能体蒸馏实现准确且高效的阶段转换决策，兼顾预测性能与在线实时监控需求，并在仿真基准与真实机器人上得到验证。

Abstract: Hierarchical planning frameworks combine skills from multiple robot control policies for long-horizon task execution, where determining when to terminate the current skill and advance to the next subtask is essential. Existing approaches often rely on pre-designed completion signal checkers that are hard to obtain in real-world execution. Large-scale vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong reasoning capabilities, but their decision boundaries are not inherently aligned with task completion criteria, while cloud deployment and lengthy reasoning introduce substantial latency, limiting real-time monitoring. We propose StageGuard, an agentic distillation framework for accurate and efficient stage-transition decisions. StageGuard combines teacher-model reasoning with demonstration trajectories to generate structured explanations of subtask completion and policy switching. A lightweight student VLM uses these explanations to generate compact self-explanations, which are used for supervised fine-tuning. We evaluate stage-transition prediction on trajectories from two benchmarks and assess closed-loop task success through integration into hierarchical robot control on BEHAVIOR-1K, with further validation on real robots. Results show substantial improvements in stage-transition prediction while supporting efficient online monitoring.

</details>


### [315] [Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20820)
*Nitish Dashora,Douglas Chen,Idan Shenfeld,John Marangola,Pulkit Agrawal,Max Simchowitz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"workspace token"：在训练时用VLM蒸馏出轻量潜在记忆表征，部署时替代观测，无需在线VLM推理即可完成记忆密集型机器人操作任务，且性能更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂机器人操作任务常需对历史事件与动作的长期记忆。以完整历史作为条件易导致策略学到虚假相关并降低性能；现有方法依赖在推理循环中做昂贵的VLM查询来压缩历史、仅保留任务显著信息，成本高，故需一种更高效的记忆表征方案。

Method: 将计算密集的VLM查询移到训练阶段：先用VLM识别完成任务所需的当前与历史信息，再通过集合重建解码器损失（set-reconstruction decoder loss）将其蒸馏进一个轻量潜在记忆——workspace token。部署时该token可作为观测的直接替代（drop-in replacement），无需在线VLM推理。

Result: 在仿真与真实硬件上均验证：workspace token 可在部署时替代观测，使策略在无需循环内VLM推理的情况下解决记忆密集型任务；且相比基线更轻量，同时带来更好的策略性能。

Conclusion: 将VLM推理从部署阶段前移到训练阶段的蒸馏思路可行且有效，workspace token 既降低在线开销，又提升策略表现，为记忆型机器人策略提供了一种高效替代方案。

Abstract: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. In this paper, we propose an alternative approach in which computationally intensive VLM queries are made during train-time to learn a lightweight latent memory that can be efficiently queried at deployment time. Our representation, which we call the \textbf{workspace token}, is trained by (1) using a VLM to identify current and historical information necessary for completing a task, then (2) distilling these into the workspace token using a set-reconstruction decoder loss. In both simulation and hardware, we show that the workspace token can be used as a drop-in replacement for observations during deployment, enabling policies to solve memory-intensive tasks without the need for VLM reasoning in-the-loop. Interestingly, we found that workspace tokens are not only more lightweight but also lead to better policy performance.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [316] [What Do We Expect from LLMs? Mapping the Design of LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19182)
*Chao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文系统梳理了2022年1月至2026年8月arXiv上14,767篇评测资源论文，揭示评测需求本身（目标系统与领域、评测材料与条件、评分机制）的演变：对行动性、交互性与专业应用的关注上升，新旧设计元素并存，LLM参与评测的程度不均衡（LLM评分增长，模型生成材料未持续增长）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM研究进展多依靠排行榜呈现，但排名本身无法反映"评测要求"如何随时间演变。作者希望从基准数量的扩张中反向观察研究者对LLM的能力期待及成功标准的变化，并追问当AI深度参与造题、答题与判分时，评测是否仍能提供独立证据。

Method: 对arXiv 2022年1月—2026年8月间14,767篇引入或更新评测资源的论文进行系统映射；采用分阶段筛选结合全文自动编码，从目标系统与领域、评测材料与条件、评分机制三个维度进行编码与纵向比较。

Result: 评测重心向行动、交互与专业应用迁移；既有与新兴设计元素常共存；模型参与呈不均衡发展：LLM评分在agent与非agent组中均增长，而模型生成评测材料在近期队列中未见同等持续上升。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了公共研究如何将能力期待转化为具体测试与成功判据；当AI同时参与构建测试、执行任务与评判回答时，评测扩张未必等同更独立的证据，可能复制参与模型的偏好与盲点。

Abstract: Benchmarks are central to how progress in large language models (LLMs) is assessed and communicated. Yet model rankings alone reveal little about how evaluation requirements themselves are changing. The expanding variety of benchmarks offers another perspective: what researchers expect LLMs to do, and what they count as successful performance. We systematically map 14,767 papers introducing or updating evaluation resources from arXiv submissions between January 2022 and August 2026. Using staged screening and automated full-text coding, we examine changes in target systems and domains, evaluation materials and conditions, and scoring mechanisms. The collection shows growing emphasis on action, interaction, and professional applications, while established and newer design elements frequently coexist. Model participation also develops unevenly: LLM-based scoring grows within both agent and non-agent groups, whereas model-generated materials show no comparable sustained increase in recent cohorts. These findings illuminate how public research translates capability expectations into concrete tests and criteria for success. As AI participates in constructing tests, performing tasks, and judging responses, they also raise a question: does expanding evaluation provide more independent evidence, or risk reproducing the preferences and blind spots of its participating models?

</details>


### [317] [Safety Beyond the Interface: Detecting Harm via Latent States in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19472)
*Alizishaan Khatri,Chiquita Prabhu,Omkar Neogi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出用轻量级MLP探针从LLaMA-3.1-8B的内部激活中检测有害提示，在多个基准上取得与千倍规模外部护栏模型相当的F1分数，同时降低延迟与算力开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主系统日益依赖LLM，但外部安全护栏会引入延迟与计算开销，限制其在资源受限、时间敏感场景中的实用性。同时，现有外部护栏模型无法洞察模型内部机制，形成根本性的保障缺口。作者由此提出核心问题：模型本身是否已经"知道"内容有害？

Method: 从LLaMA-3.1-8B中提取内部激活，训练参数量约12.6M的轻量级MLP分类器探针，用于检测有害提示。

Result: 在WildJailbreak、Beavertails和AEGIS 2.0上，探针F1分数分别为99%、83%和84%，与规模大1000倍的护栏模型相比具有竞争力，同时降低延迟与计算成本。

Conclusion: 利用模型内部激活的轻量探针可有效检测有害提示，为资源受限、时间敏感场景提供更高效的安全方案，并揭示模型内部已蕴含危害性判断信息，弥补外部护栏的保障缺口。

Abstract: Autonomous systems increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) yet the safety infrastructure surrounding these models introduces latency and compute overhead. This limits utility in resource-constrained, time-critical deployments. Existing external guardrail models remain blind to the model's internal workings, creating a fundamental assurance gap. We ask: does the model already know when the content is harmful? We extract activations from LLaMA-3.1-8B and train lightweight MLP classifier probes (12.6M parameters) to detect harmful prompts. Evaluated on WildJailbreak, Beavertails, and AEGIS 2.0, our probes achieve F1 scores of 99%, 83%, and 84%, respectively competitive with 1000x larger guard models while cutting latency and compute costs.

</details>


### [318] [EconSkills: Studying Skill Transfer and Retrieval for Web Agents on Live Economic Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19523)
*Yinzhu Quan,Zefang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 EconSkills——将已验证的经济数据检索轨迹蒸馏为参数化标准操作流程的技能库与评测框架，验证可复用网络操作程序能否跨任务迁移，并考察库规模下的检索选择效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络智能体常重复访问相同站点，但多数评测丢弃了此前成功交互中习得的操作流程，缺乏对程序性知识复用价值的系统评估。

Method: 将 EconWebArena 已验证轨迹蒸馏为参数化技能，每条技能包含范围、导航步骤、站点专属指引、验证检查与恢复步骤，并将源实例取值替换为占位符；设计两类评估：受控迁移（已知相关技能迁移到留出任务）与库规模下的技能选择检索。对比无技能提示、原始轨迹重放与抽象化技能。

Result: 受控迁移中匹配技能优于无技能提示，在配对成功案例上步骤更少，且抽象化显著优于原始轨迹重放；库规模下检索整体与无技能基线相当，在直接覆盖任务上表现最佳，但覆盖率分层显示未覆盖任务上的近似匹配会抵消部分增益；浏览器轨迹显示程序性指引可缩短门户特定导航，语义验证在某些环节仍属必要。

Conclusion: 可复用的经济类网络操作程序能够跨任务实例迁移，并为覆盖率感知的技能选择与上下文传递提供了具体设计目标。

Abstract: Web agents often revisit the same sites, yet most evaluations discard the procedures learned in earlier successful interactions. We introduce EconSkills, a skill library and evaluation framework that distills verified EconWebArena trajectories into parameterized standard operating procedures for retrieving live economic data. Each skill records its scope, navigation procedure, site-specific guidance, verification checks, and recovery steps while replacing source-instance values with placeholders. EconSkills separates two questions: whether a known relevant procedure transfers to a held-out task, and whether an agent can retain that benefit when selecting from a library. In controlled transfer, matched skills improve success over no-skill prompting and require fewer steps on paired successes, while abstraction is substantially more effective than replaying raw trajectories. At library scale, retrieval is competitive with the no-skill baseline overall and performs best on directly covered tasks; coverage-stratified outcomes show that approximate matches on uncovered tasks offset these gains. Browser trajectories further identify when procedural guidance shortens portal-specific navigation and when semantic verification remains necessary. These results establish that reusable economic web procedures can transfer across task instances and provide a concrete design target for coverage-aware selection and context delivery.

</details>


### [319] [When Hiring Becomes Agent-Mediated: Evaluating Access and Recurrence in Two-Agent Résumé Screening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19530)
*Jian Gao,Hang Jiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文研究将简历筛选从"单次调用式静态判断"改为"雇主侧与候选人侧双智能体交换证据后再决策"的方法，在600对构造的简历-职位数据上用GPT-5.5与Opus 4.7对比，发现双智能体筛选通过率更高、决策双向变化，且单次调用阈值无法复制其选出的申请，筛选流程本身而非仅底层模型决定了谁能进入人工复审及该结果的可重复性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 招聘本质上是双边过程：雇主评估匹配度，候选人则呈现并辩护自身资历。然而作为第一道关卡的简历筛选通常被自动化成对"简历-职位"配对的静态、单次调用判断，忽略了这种互动性。作者希望探究以双智能体（雇主侧与候选人侧）模拟这一双边角色、在决策前交换证据并更新判断，是否会改变筛选结果。

Method: 作者提出双智能体筛选流程：雇主侧与候选人侧智能体分别扮演对应角色，交换证据并更新各自判断，之后才决定谁进入下一轮。实验在600对构造的简历-职位配对上，使用GPT-5.5与Claude Opus 4.7两种模型，对比单次调用与双智能体两种流程；并在191对共同的"边缘样本池"上重复运行三次，统计通过实例率；此外对由发现流程选出的案例在新运行中重新执行，观察选择的可重复性。

Result: 双智能体筛选使更多申请进入下一轮：GPT-5.5从33.3%升至39.3%，Opus 4.7从34.0%升至35.5%。在191对边缘样本池三次运行中，通过实例率分别由4.5%升至26.2%（GPT-5.5）和由6.5%升至16.1%（Opus 4.7）。变化并非单向放宽：双智能体筛选会拒绝单次调用所通过的申请，决策在两个方向上都发生改变。在相近的通过量下，两种流程选出的是不同申请，且没有任何单次调用阈值能稳定复现双智能体筛选所选出的申请。在重新执行时，仅由双智能体选中的案例复现频率低于两种流程共同选中的案例（GPT-5.5下明显，Opus 4.7下较弱），而单独的"单次调用"后续复现未出现类似下降。

Conclusion: 随着招聘在雇主与候选双方都日益由智能体中介，筛选流程本身（而不仅是其背后的模型）决定了谁能进入人工复审，以及这种机会的可重复性。因此，自动化简历筛选的设计应被视为影响招聘公平与稳定的关键变量。

Abstract: Hiring is bilateral: employers assess fit, while candidates present and defend evidence of their qualifications. Yet résumé screening, the first gate, is commonly automated as a static, one-call judgment over a résumé-job pair. We study a two-agent alternative in which employer-side and candidate-side agents represent these roles, exchange evidence, and update their judgments before deciding who advances. We compare procedures on 600 constructed résumé-job pairs using GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.7. Two-agent screening advances more applications (33.3% to 39.3% for GPT-5.5; 34.0% to 35.5% for Opus 4.7). Across three runs on the common 191-pair borderline pool, pass-instance rates rise from 4.5% to 26.2% and from 6.5% to 16.1%, respectively. This is not a uniform relaxation: two-agent screening rejects applications one-call advances, changing decisions in both directions. At similar pass volumes, the procedures advance different applications, and no one-call threshold recovers applications consistently selected by two-agent screening. Among discovery-selected cases re-executed in fresh runs, two-agent-only selections recur less often than shared selections, clearly under GPT-5.5 and less certainly under Opus 4.7, while a separate one-call follow-up shows no comparable decline. As hiring becomes agent-mediated on both sides, the screening procedure, not only the model behind it, shapes who reaches human review and how reliably that access recurs.

</details>


### [320] [From Intent to Action: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Vehicle Voice Command Authorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19630)
*Diba Afroze,Xingli Zhang,Yazhou Tu,Xiali Hei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文构建含202个场景、七类参考决策的基准，评估LLM车载语音助手的预行动授权决策，发现结构化决策不足以作为独立安全机制，需独立执行层校验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM正被集成进车载语音助手，但自然语言请求与车辆功能之间的映射构成安全关键的授权问题。系统在执行前需在"执行、拒绝、澄清、要求确认、转手动控制、触发紧急响应、不调用工具"之间抉择；已有评估未针对说话人角色、认证状态、车辆状态、工具可用性隔离这一预行动决策环节。

Method: 提出202场景基准，含七类分类体系下的参考决策。评估2个本地开源权重模型与3个基于API的LLM，采用决策对齐率（Decision Alignment）与安全专用错误指标；并对Llama 3.2 3B进行受控消融实验，比较结构化授权策略与仅模式（schema-only）、通用安全基线。

Result: 对齐率从Llama 3.2 3B的40.1%到Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview的89.1%；API类模型介于83.2%–89.1%，彼此无统计显著差异。即使最优模型在161个非执行场景中仍出现2–3次误执行（False Execute），确认与手动控制决策上存在持续错误。消融显示结构化授权策略下Llama 3.2 3B对齐率为40.1%，优于仅模式与通用安全基线的28.2%–29.2%，但未能消除误执行。

Conclusion: 结构化LLM决策本身不足以充当独立安全机制；实际部署需引入独立执行层，在调用任何车辆功能前校验工具权限与车辆状态约束。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into vehicle voice assistants. But linking natural-language requests to vehicle functions creates a safety-critical authorization problem. Before executing a command, the system must choose whether to execute, refuse, clarify, require confirmation, defer to manual control, trigger an emergency response, or make no tool call. To our knowledge, prior evaluations do not isolate this pre-action decision across speaker role, authentication status, vehicle state, and tool availability. We introduce a 202-scenario benchmark with Reference Decisions under a seven-class taxonomy. We evaluate two local open-weight models and three API-based LLMs using Decision Alignment and safety-specific error metrics. Alignment ranges from 40.1% for Llama 3.2 3B to 89.1% for Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview. The API-based models score between 83.2% and 89.1%, with no statistically significant differences among them. Even these models produce two to three False Executes among 161 non-execution scenarios, and persistent errors remain in confirmation and manual-control decisions. A controlled Llama 3.2 3B ablation increases alignment to 40.1% under the structured authorization policy, versus 28.2-29.2% under schema-only and generic-safety baselines, but it does not eliminate False Executes. Structured LLM decisions are therefore insufficient as a standalone safety mechanism, and deployment requires an independent enforcement layer that verifies tool permissions and vehicle-state constraints before invoking any vehicle function.

</details>


### [321] [AutoData: Agentic Search for Pre-training Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19754)
*Yan Meng,Dhruv Srikanth,Bingchen Zhao,Zhengyao Jiang,Yuxiang Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AutoData 将预训练数据选择视为对可执行选择算法的智能体搜索问题，在夜间搜索内发现的算法超越人工设计的策展流程，并可从代理模型迁移到更大规模，提升下游 CORE 指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体已在模型与训练代码编辑上实现自动化机器学习工程，但数据（尤其是预训练数据选择）仍处于智能体优化回路之外。已有数据混合方法只针对固定域集合优化权重，搜索空间受限，无法自动发现文档级特征（词法统计、类别标签、困惑度）之间的交互作用。

Method: 提出 AutoData：将预训练数据选择建模为对逐文档特征的启发式工程，直接在可执行的选择算法空间上搜索，而非优化固定域权重。搜索空间涵盖打分、分层与随机选择规则等更丰富的程序结构；智能体借助代理模型的验证反馈，迭代精化算法，从而自动发现特征交互。

Result: 在一次夜间搜索内，AutoData 发现的算法优于现有由人工设计的策展流程；仅在小代理模型上搜索得到的配方可以迁移到更大规模，并提升下游 CORE 指标。

Conclusion: 数据工程可被视为一个智能体式机器学习问题，这将自主研究从模型与训练代码优化扩展到数据层面；数据选择算法的自动搜索与跨规模迁移是可行的。

Abstract: LLM agents have recently shown promise in automating machine learning engineering by editing model and training code under execution feedback. Data, however, remains largely outside this agentic optimisation loop. We frame pre-training data selection as heuristic engineering over per-document features, i.e., lexical statistics, categorical labels, and perplexity. We introduce AutoData, an agent that searches directly over executable selection algorithms. Unlike prior data mixture methods that optimise weights over a fixed set of domains, AutoData searches a richer program space of scoring, stratification, and stochastic selection rules, discovering feature interactions automatically by iteratively refining algorithms with validation feedback from a proxy model. Within an overnight search, AutoData discovers a selection algorithm that outperforms existing human-designed curation pipelines. Despite being searched only on this small proxy, the discovered recipe transfers to larger scales and improves the downstream metric CORE. These results suggest that data engineering can be treated as an agentic machine learning problem, extending autonomous research from model and training-code optimization to the data.

</details>


### [322] [Reproducibility is not construct validity: LLM measurement of institutionally situated communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19866)
*Veronika Batzdorfer,Carlo Romano Marcello Alessandro Santagiustina*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究以欧盟委员会AI法案咨询数据为例，证明LLM标注的高可复现性（ICC>0.99）并不等于构念效度：文本推断的立场与同一利益相关者的问卷自报立场存在系统性分歧，且分歧随群体和国别呈现规律性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在将LLM作为测量工具时，人们常以标注可复现性（如一致性、信度）作为质量证据，但可复现性只说明测量稳定，不能说明其捕捉到了预期的目标构念。作者希望区分"可复现性"与"构念效度"，并检验当同一批行为主体同时提供结构化问卷与自由文本时，两种测量是否收敛。

Method: 使用欧盟委员会AI法案公开咨询数据集，将同一利益相关者的结构化问卷回答与其自由文本咨询意见相链接。用LLM对文本进行标注，以问卷自报的对应构念为效标，计算LLM标注的组内相关系数（ICC）评估可复现性，比较文本推断得分与问卷得分的收敛程度；并按利益相关者群体（商业协会、公共机构、非商业团体等）分解分歧，使用效应量（{g}）刻画群体差异，最后对国家层面的分歧得分做空间自相关分析（Moran's I），并检验问卷所报关切与对可解释性支持之间的关联在不同分歧水平下是否稳健。

Result: LLM标注具有极高可复现性（ICC > 0.99），但与问卷自报的目标构念收敛有限。分歧存在系统性群体差异：商业协会在文本中表达的AI风险关切高于其问卷回答（{g} = +1.0），而公共机构和若干非商业团体的分歧较小或为负。分歧得分在欧盟国家间呈正空间自相关（Moran's I = 0.347，p = 0.036），提示邻国利益相关者的文本立场倾向更相似。尽管存在分歧，问卷自报关切在所有分歧水平上仍与对可解释性的支持强相关。

（注：原文未给出样本量、模型版本、提示设计、ICC具体类型及各群体置信区间等细节。）

Conclusion: LLM标注的可复现性可以与较差的构念对应性并存。将LLM用作测量工具时，应建立能分别检验可复现性、构念效度和沟通情境差异的验证流程，而不能以高一致性作为效度证据。

Abstract: High annotation reproducibility does not necessarily imply that an LLM-inferred measure captures the construct it is intended to measure. We test this distinction using a dataset from the European Commission's AI Act consultation, linking structured survey responses to free-text consultation submissions from the same stakeholders. LLM annotations of consultation submissions are highly reproducible (intraclass correlations > 0.99), yet show limited convergence with survey-reported measures of the nominal construct they were intended to approximate. Divergence between survey-and LLM-inferred text-based measures varies systematically across stakeholder groups: business associations express greater concern about AI risks in text-based consultations than in survey responses ({g} = +1.0), whereas public authorities and several nonbusiness groups show smaller or negative divergences. Divergences between scores suggest positive spatial autocorrelation across European countries (Moran's I = 0.347, p = 0.036), indicating that stakeholders from neighboring countries tend toward more similar text-based stances towards AI safety concerns. Despite divergence, survey-reported concerns remain strongly associated with support for explainability across all divergence levels. These results demonstrate that LLM annotation reproducibility can coexist with poor construct correspondence and motivate validation procedures that distinguish reproducibility, construct validity, and communication context variation when LLMs are used as measurement instruments.

</details>


### [323] [Geopolitical Divisions Across Languages in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20005)
*Maxim Chupilkin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过112种语言、67,200条回答测试GPT、Claude与Gemini对乌克兰战争相关表述的评估，发现同一AI系统在不同语言下给出的政治倾向（亲俄/亲乌）存在系统性差异，并与各国官方语言对应的现实政治立场（对俄好感、联合国投票、对乌援助）呈现相似格局。该模式在三个模型中均复现，提示信息战可能通过训练文本的语言分布塑造AI的地缘政治偏见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着人们越来越多地使用AI聊天机器人获取新闻与世界事件解释，作者关心一个核心问题：当以不同语言提出同一问题时，AI是否给出相同的政治答案。若答案随语言变化，则可能意味着模型的训练语料嵌入了特定语言社群的地缘政治立场，进而影响全球信息环境。

Method: 研究者向GPT、Claude和Gemini三个模型提交涉及乌克兰战争的20条陈述，使用112种语言进行提问，共收集67,200条回答。随后对回答按语言统计亲俄与亲乌倾向的比例，并按各国官方语言分组，将其与三类现实政治指标（民众对俄好感度、联合国涉乌投票立场、对乌援助水平）进行对照分析；同时进行稳健性检验（如剔除单条陈述对）。

Result: 亲俄与亲乌回答的比例在不同语言间存在显著差异。按官方语言分组后，回答倾向与现实世界政治分歧格局相似：相对更亲俄的回答对应民众对俄更友好、联合国投票中对乌支持更少、对乌援助更少。该总体模式在三个模型中一致出现，且在移除个别陈述对后仍然成立。

Conclusion: 同一AI系统对同一政治议题的评估会随提问语言而变化，且这种语言间差异与现实地缘政治立场分布相呼应。作者据此提出，信息战可能通过影响用于训练AI模型的文本，进而使模型继承并传播地缘政治偏见。

Abstract: People increasingly turn to AI chatbots for news and explanations of world events. But do they receive the same political answers when they ask in different languages? Here we show that the language of a question can change how the same AI systems assess the war in Ukraine. We ask GPT, Claude and Gemini to evaluate twenty statements about the war in 112 languages, collecting 67,200 responses. The balance between Russia-leaning and Ukraine-leaning responses differs across languages. When we group responses by countries' official languages, they follow a pattern resembling worldwide political divisions: relatively more Russia-leaning answers correspond to more favourable public views of Russia, less support for Ukraine in United Nations votes, and less aid to Ukraine. The broad pattern recurs across all three models and remains when individual statement pairs are removed. Our findings suggest a possible route through which information warfare may shape the text used to train AI models, which may in turn spread geopolitical biases.

</details>


### [324] [Marginal utility, matrix factorization, and the Key-Value (KV) cache: a unified information-economic framework for sovereign geo-mining inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20068)
*Caroline Gans Combe*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将经济学中的边际效用概念与矩阵分解、Transformer 的 Key-Value 缓存两个机器学习构建立理论桥梁，提出统一的"保留特征值超过影子价格的顶维"分配规则，并将其应用于地质采矿文档结构化信息抽取，报告了轻量分类器与 TIES 模型合并的诊断性实证结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者试图在经济学效用理论与机器学习中的低秩表示、缓存压缩之间建立统一的形式化联系，从而为地质采矿文档的信息抽取提供有理论依据的推理协议、模型合并与选择策略，同时追求高精度、低延迟、低成本。

Method: 理论上，证明评分矩阵的奇异值谱对应潜在因子的递减边际效用曲线，投影协方差算子的特征值谱对应学习表示的边际效用曲线，并将缓存淘汰与低秩缓存压缩视为内存预算约束下的效用最大化，三者归约为同一分配规则。应用上提出多轮推理协议、逐层 TIES 模型合并流程，以及结合抽取质量、定位漂移与能耗并以漂移的条件风险价值（CVaR）项标量化的选择策略。实证采用 1120 万参数层次分类器，单 GPU 约五分钟训练，并在 973 篇铀矿勘探语料上评估；同时诊断均匀密度 TIES 合并的退化模式。

Result: 分类器在留出测试集上取得 90.0% 的一级准确率，而专有模型在同一语料 50 篇人工审核上为 92.0%；推理延迟为每卡 2.62 毫秒，对比 API 约 2000 毫秒，且成本可忽略。均匀密度 TIES 合并诊断出可复现的退化模式：合并模型在五个地理上不同区域输出完全相同的 token 且自称高置信度；按逐层校准密度重做合并后，该签名在诊断样本上消失。全规模抽取基准（含 LoRA 微调）为预测值而非实测值。

Conclusion: 论文建立了边际效用与低秩表示、KV 缓存之间的统一理论框架，并以地质采矿信息抽取为落地场景，展示了高效轻量模型的实用性以及对 TIES 合并退化模式的诊断价值；但全规模基准仍属未验证的实证延伸，需后续工作补充。

Abstract: This paper builds a theoretical bridge between the economic notion of marginal utility and two machine-learning constructs, matrix factorization and the Key--Value cache of transformer language models. The singular value spectrum of a rating matrix is shown to be a diminishing marginal utility schedule for latent factors, the eigenvalue spectrum of the projected covariance operator to be the marginal utility schedule of a model's learned representation, and cache eviction and low-rank cache compression to be instances of constrained utility maximization under a memory budget. The three collapse into a single allocation rule: retain the top dimensions whose eigenvalue exceeds the shadow price of the binding constraint. The framework is applied to the automated extraction of structured information from geo-mining documents, where it motivates a multi-pass inference protocol, a layer-wise TIES model merging procedure, and a selection policy combining extraction quality, localization drift and energy, scalarized with a Conditional Value-at-Risk term on drift. Two empirical contributions are reported. An 11.2-million-parameter hierarchical classifier, trained in about five minutes on a single GPU, reaches 90.0 per cent level-1 accuracy on a held-out test set from a 973-document uranium-exploration corpus, against 92.0 per cent for a proprietary model on a fifty-document human audit of the same corpus, at a latency of 2.62 ms per card against approximately 2,000 ms for the API and at negligible cost. A diagnostic of uniform-density TIES merging exposes a reproducible degenerate mode in which the merged model returns token-identical outputs across five geographically distinct districts while declaring high confidence; re-executing the merge under layer-wise calibrated densities removes that signature on the diagnostic sample. The full-scale extraction benchmark, including LoRA fine-tuning, is reported as projected rather than measured and remains an empirical extension of this work.

</details>


### [325] [Language-model groups overstate consensus when replaying human deliberation on a reasoning task](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20543)
*Tengfei Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究将100个人类Wason讨论组与信念锚定的LLM智能体组进行配对重放，并用同一套编码对人与智能体评分。结果发现"完全共识率"在人类不同评分定义下为24.0%—57.0%，且智能体组的共识度显著更高；两种去盲敏感性分析（提交制比较与参与度匹配比较）得到的差距分别约为34—44个百分点，且相互收敛在0.5个百分点以内。该差距在去除早停与去除可记忆答案后依然存在。模拟共识并不追踪集体准确性，信念锚定智能体组在该情境下是有偏的人类组结果分布估计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 完全共识率常被当作集体认知的指标，但其取值高度依赖"参与"与"最终状态"的操作化定义。作者希望检验：当把人类讨论组的共识率与配对LLM智能体组的共识率放在同一评分框架下比较时，二者差异有多大、差异是否由测量不对称（如人类沉默者 vs 智能体几乎总发言）造成，从而为评估"模拟群体能否估计人类审议结果"提供评分显式的依据。

Method: 对100个留出的人类Wason讨论组，用匹配的LLM智能体组重放；以每位参与者讨论前答案为种子，为每人设置一个信念锚定智能体；用同一套评分代码对人与智能体进行编码评分。比较人类不同评分定义下的共识率，并开展两项去盲（post-unblinding）敏感性分析：一是基于提交的比较（n=98），二是参与度匹配的比较（n=45），分别处理不同的测量不对称。此外进行去除早停、以及去除可记忆答案的重参数化检验。

Result: 人类评分定义下完全共识率估计范围为24.0%—57.0%；约五分之一人类参与者从未发帖，而智能体几乎总是发帖。两种敏感性分析中智能体组均更具共识：提交制比较（n=98）在聊天与推理模式下差距分别为34.0与43.9个百分点；参与度匹配比较（n=45）差距分别为34.1与44.4个百分点。两种路径虽减少的测量不对称不同，但结果收敛在0.5个百分点以内。去除早停与去除可记忆答案后差距仍存在，此时推理模式组几乎一致同意，且多数同意的是错误答案。模拟共识不追踪集体准确性，信念锚定智能体组在该情境下是人群组结果分布的有偏估计量。

Conclusion: 完全共识率对评分与参与操作化高度敏感，直接比较人机共识率会产生系统性偏差。即便采用互补的敏感性分析路径来减少测量不对称，LLM智能体组仍表现出高于人类的共识度，且这种模拟共识与集体准确性脱钩。因此，在用人机配对模拟估计人类审议结果时，必须明确评分规则；信念锚定智能体组不能作为该情境下人类组结果分布的无偏估计量。

Abstract: Full-consensus rates are often treated as indicators of collective cognition, yet depend on how participation and final states are operationalized. We replayed 100 held-out human Wason groups with matched large language model (LLM) agent groups, seeding one belief-anchored agent per participant's pre-discussion answer and scoring agents and people with the same code. Across human scoring definitions, estimates ranged from 24.0% to 57.0%; about one fifth of participants never posted, whereas agents almost always did. Agent groups remained more consensual in two post-unblinding sensitivity analyses: the submit-based comparison (n = 98) yielded gaps of 34.0 and 43.9 percentage points for chat and reasoning modes, and the participation-matched comparison (n = 45) yielded gaps of 34.1 and 44.4 points. These complementary routes reduced different measurement asymmetries yet converged within 0.5 percentage points. The gap persisted without early stopping and under a reparameterization removing the memorizable answer; reasoning-mode groups then agreed nearly unanimously, mostly on incorrect answers. Simulated consensus did not track collective accuracy, and belief-anchored agent groups were biased estimators of the human group-outcome distribution in this setting. These analyses provide a scoring-explicit basis for assessing simulated-group estimates of human deliberative outcomes.

</details>


### [326] [PAA: The Probabilistic Allen Algebra: A Generative and Complete Probabilistic Extension of Allen's Interval Relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20634)
*Julian Eggert*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出概率化Allen代数（PAA），将十三条时间关系建模为区间边界分布下的概率预测，实现可解释、可分级的定性时间推理框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Allen区间代数的十三条基关系是精确边界上的硬谓词，无法处理语言、感知、数据库和不确定历史中边界、时长与时刻的不确定性，也无法表达"刚之前""大约在…期间"这类具有程度语义的模糊时间表达。

Method: 采用生成式、完备的扩展方式：时间点为高斯分布，区间由高斯中点和截断高斯时长构成；所有关系统一为同一概率空间中的边界序谓词。点-点关系化为误差函数，点-区间与区间-区间关系化为线性不等式诱导的多元高斯正交概率；通过容差带使接触关系（meets、starts、finishes、equals）获得正测度，并在单一容差下使十三条关系构成真正划分。各关系进一步按CIDOC CRM思想分解为相关感知的时间原语。

Result: 粗粒度谓词（先于、重叠、包含等）被推导为叶节点关系的并集，其概率为叶概率之和；该层级结构在区间退化为点时得以保持，十三条关系依次归约为五条与三条。代数尺度不变，能将"shortly before"等程度表达与接触关系区分开。所有结果经蒙特卡洛验证，并发布为开源、带测试的Python包。

Conclusion: PAA以概率分布取代评分赋值，从边界序谓词推导出Allen分类体系，为不确定时间信息提供尺度不变、可分层、可解释的定性-定量统一代数框架。

Abstract: Allen's interval algebra is a qualitative calculus for temporal relations, but its thirteen base relations are crisp predicates over exact interval boundaries. This is inadequate for temporal information from language, perception, databases, or uncertain histories, where times, durations, and boundaries are uncertain and expressions such as "just before" or "roughly during" have graded meaning. We develop the probabilistic Allen algebra (PAA): a generative and complete extension in which relation probabilities are derived from distributions over interval boundaries rather than assigned as scores. Time points are Gaussian; intervals have Gaussian midpoints and truncated-Gaussian durations. Every relation is a boundary-ordering predicate in one common probability space: point-point relations reduce to error functions, and point-interval and interval-interval relations to multivariate Gaussian orthant probabilities induced by linear inequalities. Contact relations (meets, starts, finishes, equals) receive positive measure through a tolerance band, and under a single tolerance the thirteen relations form a true partition that recovers crisp Allen as the tolerance vanishes. The construction derives Allen's taxonomy rather than positing it: coarse predicates such as precedence, overlap, and containment are unions of leaves whose probabilities are leaf sums, and this hierarchy is preserved as intervals collapse to points and thirteen relations reduce to five and then three. Each relation further decomposes into correlation-aware temporal primitives in the spirit of CIDOC CRM. The algebra is scale-invariant and separates graded expressions such as "shortly before" from contact relations. All results are Monte-Carlo validated and shipped as an open, tested Python package.

</details>


### [327] [An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20804)
*Run-Ze Fan,Zihao Zhang,Simin Ma,Yebowen Hu,Shouju Wang,Kaiqiang Song,Fei Liu,Hamed Zamani,Xiaoyang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究将编程harness解构为规划、动作空间与上下文管理三个可变组件，在4个模型、SWE-Bench Verified与Terminal-Bench 2.1上评估176个匹配设置，发现上下文管理在预算收紧时价值最大（主要避免溢出失败），规则式消解+LLM摘要效率最优，规划对弱模型是精度支架、对强模型是成本节省器，预定义工具利于bash弱模型而纯bash界面利于强模型降本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作通常将coding harness视为单体系统进行评估，无法明确各独立组件的有效性，缺乏组件级的对比理解。作者希望厘清规划、动作空间、上下文管理等组件如何影响自主编程代理的长程软件工程表现，从而指导模型与预算感知的harness设计。

Method: 采用一个轻量级coding harness，固定执行循环，仅变化三个组件：规划（planning）、动作空间（action space）与上下文管理（context management）。在4个模型上、于SWE-Bench Verified和Terminal-Bench 2.1上评估176个匹配设置，覆盖5种上下文管理策略、4种上下文窗口预算，以及针对规划与动作空间的有向消融实验，并进行轨迹级分析。

Result: (1) 上下文管理随预算收紧价值上升，收益主要来自避免上下文溢出失败；(2) 先规则式消解再LLM摘要整体效率最高，而使消解内容可恢复增加机制但模型很少使用且无精度增益；(3) 规划对弱模型是精度支架、对强模型转为成本节省器，精度变化不大；(4) 预定义工具提升bash能力较弱模型的表现，而bash熟练模型可用纯bash界面高效运行并显著降低成本，尤其在命令行任务上。轨迹分析显示：上下文管理延长执行轨迹但不显著改变行为，规划改变轨迹停止位置，动作空间改变代码编写粒度。

Conclusion: harness组件的影响高度依赖于模型能力与上下文预算，设计应做到模型感知与预算感知；本研究提供了一个模块化框架，用于评估未来harness组件。

Abstract: Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-line-centric tasks. Trajectory-level analysis explains these effects: context management extends execution trajectories without substantially altering agent behavior, planning changes where trajectories stop, and the action space changes the granularity at which code is written. These findings inform model- and budget-aware harness design and provide a modular framework for evaluating future harness components.

</details>


### [328] [Characterizing Web Search by Conversational LLM Agents: From Search Decisions and Strategies to Results and Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19244)
*Mahsa Amani,Seungeon Lee,Abhisek Dash,Asmaa El Fraihi,Yunah Jang,Elisabeth Kirsten,Qinyuan Wu,Krishna P. Gummadi,Manish Gupta,Abhilasha Ravichander,Muhammad Bilal Zafar,Soumi Das*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 首个跨ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek四大对话平台的智能体搜索研究，结合真实用户交互（invivo）与API控制实验（invitro），系统刻画了从搜索触发、查询构建、结果获取到答案生成的端到端流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式LLM智能体日益依赖Web搜索，但其智能体搜索的端到端生命周期仍缺乏系统理解，尤其在搜索触发决策、查询策略、结果域偏好与答案归因等环节存在认知空白。

Method: 采用invivo（真实用户交互）与invitro（通过API调用同一平台模型）相结合的双轨实验设计，对ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、DeepSeek四个主流对话平台进行Web搜索全流程分析，覆盖搜索调用决策、查询构建策略、搜索结果域偏好以及结果向有据回答的转化。

Result: 搜索调用决策在不同平台与模型间差异显著，更频繁的搜索调用并不必然提升回答质量；各对话智能体采用不同的复杂查询策略，平台自有搜索引擎倾向于返回其偏好域名的结果；回答虽大体基于搜索结果，但部分论断依赖未被引用的搜索结果，存在归因与可靠性隐患。

Conclusion: 该研究揭示了对话式智能体搜索的关键行为特征与风险，对未来面向对话检索优化的AI智能体与Web搜索工具设计具有重要启示。

Abstract: Conversational LLM agents increasingly rely on Web search, yet the end-to-end lifecycle of agentic search remains poorly understood. We present the first study of Web search across four major conversational platforms (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and DeepSeek), combining real-world user interactions (invivo) with controlled experiments using the same platform's models by their APIs (invitro). We investigate the quality of agentic decisions to invoke Web search, their strategies to formulate queries, the potential domain preferences in the search results they receive, and the choices they make when transforming search results into grounded responses. We find that Web-search decisions vary substantially across platforms and models, while more frequent Web-search invocation does not necessarily yield better response quality. We further show that conversational agents employ different complex querying strategies and that platform specific search engines return search results from their preferred domains. Finally, although responses are largely grounded in search results, some claims rely on uncited search results, raising concerns about attribution and reliability. Our findings have important implications for the design of future AI agents and Web search tools optimized for conversational retrieval.

</details>


### [329] [FINSKILLOPS: A Self-Evolving Multi-Agent System for SEC Filing QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19680)
*Yanzhang Ma,Zhenghan Tai,Hanwei Wu,Sizhe Guan,Jianliang Lei,Hailin He,Chaolong Jiang,Jijun Chi,Tung Sum Thomas Kwok,Bohuai Xiao,Jingrui Tian,Xinlu Wu,Xingao Zhan,Peng Lu,Muzhi Li,Yihong Wu,Liheng Ma,Sicheng Lyu,Tianshuo Yan,Junhao Zhu,Yaqian Xu,Lei Ding,Yufei Cui,Ziquan Liu,Boyu Han,Hengli Liu,Ling Zhou,Xinyu Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出将金融问答系统的部署后改进视为"受控行为维护"，通过FINSKILLOPS多智能体系统实现技能补丁的作用域化生成、验证与生命周期管理，从而在提升正确率的同时杜绝回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融QA系统在部署前通过检索、提示或智能体协同优化，但部署后可靠性行为固定不变。实际中新的SEC文件问题反复暴露期间、实体、证据使用与计算等异构错误。既有自我改进方法能将失败转化为新行为，却难以控制修正的适用范围，也无法避免破坏原已正确的答案。

Method: 将部署后改进建模为受控行为维护：频繁失败应转化为作用域受限的技能补丁（scoped skill patches），每个补丁需在无回归的前提下通过准入。基于此构建FINSKILLOPS多智能体SEC文件问答系统，从基于证据的、带类型的失败诊断中提炼可复用技能，并通过定向验证、受保护用例回归检查、负对照以及版本化替换/退役进行治理。

Result: 在六个金融QA基准上，单一冻结技能注册表在所评估系统中取得最高裁决加权正确率与参考一致性。进化后技能在增强基准上把正确率从3.70提升至4.55。在独立的12轮运行研究中，33个候选技能仅6个被晋升，监控非正确率由20.0%降至12.5%。

Conclusion: 受控的技能作用域、准入机制与生命周期管理是实现可靠自我改进的基础，为金融QA系统的部署后持续演化提供了可控且可验证的范式。

Abstract: Financial QA systems are typically improved before deployment through better retrieval, prompting, or agent coordination, leaving their reliability behavior fixed thereafter. In practice, new SEC-filing questions repeatedly expose heterogeneous errors in period, entity, evidence use, and calculation. Existing self-improvement methods can turn failures into new behaviors, but offer limited control over where a correction should apply or which previously correct answers it may break. We therefore frame post-deployment improvement as controlled behavioral maintenance: recurring failures should become scoped skill patches, and each patch should earn deployment with- out introducing regressions. We instantiate this view in FINSKILLOPS, a multi-agent system for SEC filing QA. FINSKILLOPS derives reusable skills from evidence-grounded, typed failure diagnoses and governs them through targeted validation, protected-case regression checks, negative controls, and versioned replacement or retirement. Across six financial QA benchmarks, a single frozen skill registry achieves the highest verdict-weighted correctness and reference consistency among the evaluated systems. Evolved skills raise correctness from 3.70 to 4.55 on our enhanced benchmark. In a separate 12-round operational study, only six of 33 proposed skills are promoted, while the monitoring non-correct rate falls from 20.0% to 12.5%. These results establish controlled skill scope, admission, and lifecycle management as the foundation for reliable self-improvement.

</details>


### [330] [Constraint-Safe Graph-Context Scoring for Stable Point-Feature Labels Under Text-Width and Accessibility-Inspired Profiles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19848)
*Taimoor Ahmad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LABELSENSE-Pilot 是一个可复现的点要素标注布局原型：为每要素生成 8 个罗盘候选位，用 MLP 基于图上下文摘要打分并加入前次放置奖励，经混合整数优化选局，再校验视口包含、唯一性与两两间距。实验显示 85.62% 显示率、2.09% 闪烁、零碰撞，但作者强调其为工程权衡原型，非人类可访问性/多语言可用性证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互地图的点要素标注需同时满足几何有效性、显示产量、局部放置效用与相机运动下的稳定性；可访问性与多语言需求会改变标注尺寸，但既有算法评估常将其简化为重叠计数。作者希望提供可审计、可复现的工程权衡原型，并明确区分工程指标与人类可用性证据。

Method: LABELSENSE-Pilot 为每个要素生成八个罗盘候选位置；采用多层感知机（MLP）对图上下文摘要进行候选打分，叠加前次放置奖励（previous-placement bonus）；再通过混合整数优化（mixed-integer optimization）选择布局。执行打分器被明确声明并非图变换器（graph transformer）。每个返回布局均检查视口包含、每要素唯一性与两两间距（clearance）。实验使用覆盖 155 个国家的 2,500 个机场坐标与名称，采用按国家分组划分，并生成密度、相机、文本后缀、偏好与放大字体等压力条件；跨五个随机种子评估。

Result: 五个种子下，LABELSENSE-Pilot 显示 85.62% 标注，闪烁 2.09%，零碰撞。对比手工效用整数规划，显示率牺牲 1.43 个百分点，但闪烁降低 12.04 个百分点。放大框感知布局产生零代理违规（zero proxy violations），而标准几何在 1.5 倍重评估时，52.57% 的选中放置发生违规。

Conclusion: 结果确立的是一种可审计的工程权衡，而非人类可访问性、多语言可用性或偏好结论。正式投稿前仍需官方近期基线（recent baselines）与参与者证据（participant evidence）。

Abstract: Point-feature label placement on interactive maps must reconcile geometric validity, display yield, local placement utility, and stability across camera motion. Accessibility and multilingual requirements further change label dimensions, yet algorithmic evaluations often collapse these concerns into overlap counts. We present LABELSENSE-Pilot, a reproducible prototype that generates eight compass candidates per feature, scores candidates with a multilayer perceptron over graph-context summaries, adds a previous-placement bonus, and selects a layout through mixed-integer optimization. The executed scorer is deliberately not described as a graph transformer. Every returned layout is checked for viewport containment, per-feature uniqueness, and pairwise clearance. Experiments use 2,500 airport coordinates and names spanning 155 countries, with country-grouped splits and generated density, camera, text-suffix, preference, and enlarged-font stressors. Across five seeds, LABELSENSE-Pilot displayed 85.62 percent of labels with 2.09 percent flicker and zero collisions. Versus a handcrafted-utility integer program, LABELSENSE-Pilot sacrificed 1.43 percentage points of display while reducing flicker by 12.04 points. Enlarged-box-aware layouts produced zero proxy violations, whereas standard geometry reevaluated at 1.5x violated 52.57 percent of selected placements. These results establish an auditable engineering trade-off, not human accessibility, multilingual usability, or preference. Official recent baselines and participant evidence remain required before submission.

</details>


### [331] [JEPA-WAM: Connecting Generated Visual Instructions to World Action Models through JEPA Latent Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.20277)
*Tianbin Liu,Jian Zhu,Taiyi Su,Jianjun Zhang,Chong Ma,Zitai Huang,Yi Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 JEPA-WAM，通过为文本指令生成多样化视觉目标参考（用冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 编码）来增强世界动作模型的指令跟随能力，并在真实机器人基准上大幅超越 π0 与 Fast-WAM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 WAM 在仅以文本指令为条件时指令跟随能力有限，作者认为部分原因是机器人学习数据的结构性失衡：视觉-动作轨迹丰富，但语言标注稀疏且重复，使策略倾向于从视觉上下文和运动规律中识别任务，而非真正基于指令进行落地。

Method: JEPA-WAM 为每条文本指令附加一组随机生成的视觉指令：用现成的文本到图像生成器（不训练）按指令采样多张任务完成图像，作为与指令语义对齐但外观/布局可能不同的视觉目标参考；再用冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器提取任务级语义，将稠密目标表示压缩为紧凑的 goal tokens，通过交叉注意力同时条件化视频专家与动作专家。

Result: 构建了覆盖分布内、分布外场景和分布外指令三种设置的真实机器人指令跟随基准；JEPA-WAM 在三种设置下成功率分别为 87.3%、74.5%、80.9%，分别比 π0 和 Fast-WAM 高出至少 10.0、27.3 和 14.5 个百分点。

Conclusion: 用生成式视觉目标参考弥补语言标注稀疏问题，可有效提升 WAM 的指令落地与泛化能力，在分布外场景与指令条件下优势尤为明显。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated strong robotic manipulation capabilities by augmenting pretrained video generative models with action experts. However, current WAMs still show limited instruction-following ability when conditioned solely on text instructions. We argue that this limitation stems in part from a structural imbalance in robot-learning data: rich visual-action trajectories are often paired with sparse and repetitive language annotations, allowing policies to identify tasks from visual context and motion regularities rather than grounding the instruction itself. To address this limitation, we introduce JEPA-WAM, which augments each text instruction with a bank of stochastically generated visual instructions, providing diverse visual cues for instruction following. Specifically, JEPA-WAM uses an off-the-shelf text-to-image generator to sample multiple task-completion images conditioned on the text instruction, without training the generator. Although these generated images may differ from the current visual scene in appearance and layout, they remain semantically aligned with the instruction and serve as visual goal references. To focus on task-level semantics beyond appearance, we encode these references with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder. The resulting dense goal representations are compressed into compact goal tokens that condition both the video and action experts through cross-attention. We further construct a real-robot instruction-following benchmark covering in-distribution, out-of-distribution scene, and out-of-distribution instruction settings. On this benchmark, JEPA-WAM achieves success rates of 87.3%, 74.5%, and 80.9% in these three settings, outperforming π0 and Fast-WAM by at least 10.0, 27.3, and 14.5 percentage points, respectively.

</details>


### [332] [Dual-Axis Policy Optimization for LLM Agents: Bayesian Feedback Attribution and Trajectory Mass Normalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19830)
*Yingxuan Zhuang,Binhe Yu,Jingxiao Yang,Ruopei Sun,Ziting Li,Cheng Tan,Xuhong Zhang,Jianwei Yin,Jintao Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出BATON双轴策略优化框架：一方面用贝叶斯反馈归因建模轨迹内反馈，另一方面用轨迹质量归一化在批次内均衡完整轨迹的优化权重，实验证明两轴独立有效且组合最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体强化学习存在两个不同的优化维度：轨迹内如何利用环境反馈，以及批次内如何聚合完整轨迹。现有方法未将这两个维度显式解耦并统一处理，因此需要分别形式化并设计针对性机制。

Method: BATON框架包含两个轴：第一轴为Bayesian Feedback Attribution（贝叶斯反馈归因），针对轨迹内反馈归因，在采样动作上构建以反馈为条件的后验分布；第二轴为Trajectory Mass Normalization（TMN，轨迹质量归一化），针对轨迹间目标聚合，为每条完整轨迹分配相等的优化质量。两轴分别实例化Intra-Trajectory Feedback Attribution与Inter-Trajectory Objective Aggregation。

Result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop和SearchQA上，结合GRPO与GiGPO进行实验，结果表明两个轴各自带来独立增益，二者结合在不同模型规模下均一致取得最强的整体性能。

Conclusion: 将LLM智能体强化学习解耦为轨迹内反馈归因与轨迹间目标聚合两个维度是有效的；BATON通过贝叶斯反馈归因与轨迹质量归一化实现双轴优化，验证了两轴的独立性与互补性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning for LLM agents involves two distinct optimization di- mensions: how environment feedback is exploited within a trajectory, and how complete trajectories are aggregated across a batch. We formulate these dimen- sions as Intra-Trajectory Feedback Attribution and Inter-Trajectory Objec- tive Aggregation, and introduce BATON (Bayesian Attribution and Trajectory Objective Normalization), a dual-axis policy optimization framework. BATON instantiates the first axis with Bayesian Feedback Attribution, which constructs a feedback-conditioned posterior over sampled actions, and the second with Trajec- tory Mass Normalization (TMN), which assigns equal optimization mass to com- plete trajectories. Experiments with GRPO and GiGPO on ALFWorld, WebShop, and SearchQA show that both axes provide independent gains and that their combi- nation consistently achieves the strongest overall performance across model scales.

</details>


### [333] [Position: It is Time to Virtualize Foundation Models with a Self-evolving Operating System Layer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19203)
*Suparna Bhattacharya,Tarun Kumar,Cong Xu,Satish Kumar Mopur,Jiahao Li,Ashish Mishra,Aalap Tripathy,Annmary Justine Koomthanam,Martin Foltin,Ian Foster*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该立场论文主张：随着AI应用从单一基础模型转向复合智能体系统，需要构建"基础模型操作系统（FMOS）"，作为虚拟化FM交互的系统层，像虚拟机抽象硬件一样，为应用提供专用、可信且能力近乎无限的FM实例假象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前AI技术栈高度碎片化：尽管MCP、A2A等协议缓解了工具与智能体的连接问题，但各框架各自内嵌了针对状态、记忆、预算和护栏的隐式运行时，导致行为不可移植、治理脆弱。作者认为这类似于操作系统出现之前、每个程序都要重复实现基础服务的计算时代，因此亟需统一系统层。

Method: 作为立场论文，本文提出FMOS的架构设想与设计原则，而非具体实验实现。其核心思想是将FM交互虚拟化：对内编排跨记忆层级的知识、模型选择与资源分配、验证与策略执行；对外为应用屏蔽底层复杂性。设计上借鉴人脑"快直觉—慢审慎"的双系统切换机制，使FMOS学习何时介入、何时直接放行推理，并基于运行经验持续自适应调整策略。

Result: 本文为立场性论述，未提供实证结果，主要贡献是提出FMOS的概念框架、类比论证（虚拟机对硬件的抽象、操作系统对计算服务的统一）及其应具备的核心内部编排能力（记忆分层、模型选择、资源调度、验证与策略执行）。

Conclusion: 作者呼吁领域转向构建FMOS这一系统层，以解决当前智能体栈的碎片化与治理脆弱问题，实现行为可移植、可信且能力可扩展的FM应用生态；并提出以大脑快慢双系统切换为隐喻，让FMOS学习自适应的介入策略。

Abstract: AI applications have shifted from single, monolithic foundation models (FM) to compound agentic systems. Yet today's stacks remain fragmented: even as protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) ease tool/agent connectivity, each framework embeds an implicit runtime for state, memory, budgets, and guardrails, making behavior non-portable and governance brittle. It mirrors computing before operating systems, when every program re-implemented basic services. This position paper argues that the field now needs a Foundation Model Operating System (FMOS) -- a system layer that virtualizes FM interactions analogous to how virtual machines abstract physical hardware, giving applications the illusion of dedicated, trustworthy FM instances with effectively unbounded capabilities. Internally, the FMOS orchestrates knowledge across memory tiers, model selection and resource allocation, and verification and policy enforcement. Like the human brain switching between fast intuition and slow deliberation, the FMOS learns when to intervene and when to let inference proceed directly and continuously adapting its policies based on operational experience.

</details>


### [334] [Compositional Reasoning in Language Models under Reinforcement Learning Post-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.19465)
*Yu He,Yingxi Li,Yifei Wang,Ellen Vitercik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出依赖图框架形式化组合推理，并发现"分解到组合"的不对称性：分解技能训练难以迁移到组合任务，而组合任务训练更易回迁到分解任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实问题求解依赖组合推理：训练数据有限，模型必须通过以新方式组合已学技能来泛化。尽管RL等后训练方法显著提升了LM的推理能力，但其对组合推理的影响仍缺乏理解，且缺乏形式化的组合性刻画。

Method: 提出依赖图（dependency-graph）框架形式化组合推理，定义三个复杂度递增的组合性层级；用数据结构任务实例化该框架，以获得确定性奖励计算和清晰的组合结构；进行理论分析解释不对称性，并在长度外推、结构分布偏移、未见技能迁移等设定下评估组合泛化，另开展真实工具调用基准的试点研究。

Result: 观察到一致的"分解到组合"不对称性：分解技能训练不能可靠迁移到组合任务，而组合任务训练更容易反向迁移到分解任务；理论解释支持该现象；在长度外推、结构分布偏移及迁移到需未见技能的任务下评估了组合泛化；真实工具调用基准上初步证据表明该不对称性可延伸到实际场景。

Conclusion: 组合推理存在系统性的方向不对称性，依赖图框架可形式化并指导评估；训练应重视组合任务以促进双向迁移，该现象在真实工具调用中具有初步外推性。

Abstract: Compositional reasoning is critical for real-world problem solving: since training data is necessarily limited, models must generalize by composing learned skills in new ways. While post-training methods such as reinforcement learning (RL) have substantially improved the reasoning abilities of language models (LMs), their effects on compositional reasoning remain less well understood. We propose a dependency-graph framework to formalize compositional reasoning, yielding three levels of compositionality with increasing complexity. Empirically, we instantiate this framework with data-structure tasks, which provide deterministic reward computation and clear compositional structure. We find a consistent decomposed-to-composed asymmetry: decomposed-skill training does not reliably transfer to composed tasks, whereas composed-task training transfers more readily back to decomposed tasks. We provide theoretical explanation for this asymmetry, and further evaluate compositional generalization under length extrapolation, structural distribution shift, and transfer to tasks requiring unseen skills. Finally, we present a pilot study on real-world tool-calling benchmarks, showing preliminary evidence that the decomposed-to-composed asymmetry can extend to practical settings.

</details>
